Hey, it’s Athena, Tina’s finance director, and I just made a difficult decision: [**I gave our team the green light to spend more than we planned to keep Tina’s new ads on the air through August.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137196364/639954876/1974481312?refcode=email_081326_financeupdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTE3MTlmMy03Mzk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MZaqyy6viPPZfCB2qNZszL9QAcE1CQjbwEZm2JLOjXU=) And I’ll be honest with you, Peter — that wasn’t an easy call. The money wasn’t sitting in our budget. But with Election Day right around the corner and the latest polls showing this race is neck-and-neck, I knew we couldn’t afford to sit back. Tina’s message needs to reach as many Oregonians as possible — and that means keeping our ads live at this critical moment. It’s a risk. | | | | | |
A catering truck pulled up to Air Force One in Turkey. The President got in. The press flew out on the plane he wasn't on! Wild story.

Plus, [Jay McCleskey is with us for this special episode.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ceed0aaa5d&e=567664f14c) We’re covering the quietest governor's race anyone can remember, and the body cam footage from a 13-year-old's rescue that every newsroom in the state reported as an “Albuquerque man.” Plus one of the best universities in the country just stopped giving freshmen grades.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7e6c972eed&e=567664f14c)
| | 🔥 **TRUMP SNUCK OFF AIR FORCE ONE IN TURKEY — THE PRESS FLEW THE DECOY**
The cameras caught him walking up the stairs in Ankara. Minutes later a catering truck pulled away from the far side of the plane.
Scott Jennings went on CNN and said the story raised the hair on the back of his neck. He also explained what level of threat it takes before anyone makes that call.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=78b00d2fb6&e=567664f14c)
---
| | 👮 **THE STORY EVERY NEWSROOM FILED AS "ALBUQUERQUE MAN"**
Jay McCleskey brings the body cam footage from a 13-year-old girl's rescue in Rio Rancho.
Every outlet in the state reported a 34-year-old “Albuquerque man”. Jay has what the officers saw. There's one detail in that video that changes the whole story, and not a single newsroom included it.
He's now suing Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham's office to keep this footage coming. Wait until you hear what the legislature has planned for next session.
▶️ [**WATCH BREAKING BODY CAMS**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=b85ad4d42d&e=567664f14c)**

**🏛️**THE SILENT GOVERNOR RACE**
Six weeks from early voting, Deb Haaland isn't attacking. Gregg Hull isn't on TV. Krysty can't find a yard sign anywhere. What the heck?!
Jay says the silence is the most dangerous signal in this race, and he explains why quiet from a campaign with that much money should scare you more than an attack ad would.
Then he says something about Hull's own poll we did not expect him to say out loud...

📚 **MICHIGAN JUST STOPPED GIVING FRESHMEN GRADES**
One of the best public universities in the country will show first-semester students "pass" or "no credit" and nothing else. Krysty connects it to a state where law school graduates can't pass the easiest bar exam in America, and where APS just gave kids a "soft launch" instead of a first day of school.

I’m sitting in the Rose Garden right now sipping a Trump Diet Soda.
**Gorgeous day. Beautiful garden. Greatest soda ever made, and I’m not just saying that, believe me. It’s true!**
But something’s been on my mind. I haven’t heard from you in a while!
**I’m sitting here in the most beautiful garden in the world, maybe the most beautiful garden anywhere, and all I keep thinking about is whether you’re still with me.**

[STAND WITH TRUMP](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujnXS9GI5MVarOXJGkI14H1i5A8emTOI5iJ04TynYedovpF3LM6l0Rw53Fe3Rucdz0GBfM7R4ouckytc7djIgZ-PtAYOrUcwMMbAfEzyHpKDoCYy4Mr0GwZ5saEuXNOVABvBqUE-efg9BKCuyKXMW3YVaycgFp2wW9ypKTbnGYtBA%3D)
Look, I don’t reach out like this to just anyone. I’m very selective. The people I think about, the people I keep coming back to, that’s a very short list.
Many people are saying it’s too short!
But you’re on it. You’ve always been on it!
**[Through every fight, every witch hunt, every disgusting, phony attempt to take me down, you were there. Completely and totally loyal.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujeABwcvxJITuVftTabiFx_yCeESHd_HERy_AhoYc6LZmu7wBGFdKMDAL5b_cAOKL2s8KnTUUMTlRwzGuLW6Su4i5VFCoE0AzN3IN4Lx44Sg68junoZf9A8_ex8ntxTrUg4-WyTJ1TjlvlV7pBRy5G-12te6RQktsvzkqE0UTPTGk%3D)**

[I love loyalty! ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujZ6GXuJ3XQ3S3kTjOKB91bTWmKHEca3wClZ6cBQA1h4qmM4O2fHE54eq8I5GyBodDYYF2FcN8GL1PPicyA94oRGBeI_-dShiTuZJ-ZmdRcyXRd26UqtfqRfVOxU1AKg_M4N8MMkJT7L9zIHQWr90mgTCwYcgB5uWkLoc6-PkCTu0%3D)
That means more to me than this beautiful garden, this gorgeous day, and yes, even this incredible soda. Believe me.

**[Before my soda gets warm, let me hear from you.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8a199be4855b418d86be726566010145&_e=M4DCAQxgjCwDWMURBEvDEYiEkdumNfH5x7b_qp3XDN7i1krD6U9oNzEMwsGxL_4WNB16mzSHNMCg5UMKKOGGyutFprJn_fSr4sLANE_11KOOtXkGT77IyUCeINTnafgc9JiLHNNRJb-oj1_mwoTkBALq8JFSuVlv1HI9SFaumBbQF3QpgSEmYjMc3HP625yi4zOKdqEhGB-s-5gTDbGRZAAWV6DTHgnb5tgyjQjQUrOoKtIovYWmrWZJNkAW5MopN3sXuc8eizWfB2BSCUZS4OWcWKQr_GcARC13HxQNJ6_P-9niOJKkL0_1QJfsQLujjfZVQBCCaaBJr--juNTZ_OfznHSoQDE4YEvThqFprmC_ba3xLbEIaV6CZ54xxAfE2fz078LBabLMz66846E7ESCKEktg_PX4MWqEq0LYPhIIWuRdi7shVwFYAXSR7-u2oc4lmc2KJ9gxwqFgUOdMePSyX19_mvYxuUB5Nusfxb8%3D)**

body:
---

---
Derek,
I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash.
We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet.
My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly.
_“Take the pay cut or go home,”_ they were told.
I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family.
I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too.
And it’s _that fight_ I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians.
Now’s our chance to change that. Derek, we have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families.
[**So that’s why I have to ask: can you chip in $20 split between my campaign and the DNC to defeat Collins and take back our Democratic majority?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-jackson-split?refcode=em_20260813_8569_fr&amount=20&refcode2=8569_22930333_eCnXNb&akid=8569%2E22930333%2EeCnXNb)

body:
Corporations are draining our water supply — our candidates aren’t going down without a fight.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260813-2&t=1&akid=3869%2E587540%2EXFl6PD)
Peter,
A couple weeks ago, **Trump stood at the EPA headquarters and told communities across the country they can’t fight data centers and the corporations draining their water supply.** He said they should just embrace them.
Here’s the reality: across the country, corporations are quietly draining America’s water supply. They’re spiking energy bills just to cool their data centers and contaminating drinking water people depend on to survive. **And the ones paying the price are the working families who never got a say on any of it.**
But listen — _Trump is wrong._ Communities across the country have already been fighting back against corporate water exploitation, _and winning._
They’ll continue to do so with bold, principled leaders like our candidates by their sides.
In Georgia, our candidate **Ruwa Romman** introduced the first statewide data center moratorium in history.
**Jacob Martinez** and **Armando Montero** are fighting back in Arizona, where corporations are pumping out groundwater that Arizonans have relied on for decades. They’re both pushing for stricter groundwater protections and corporate water transparency so communities — not corporations — get to decide what happens with their resources.
And **Leila Staton** is running in Iowa, where industrial water users have left communities facing contaminated drinking water and a water crisis so severe it’s forcing watering bans across the state. She’s fighting to put real restrictions on industrial water use and make corporations pay for the damage they’ve caused.
These are the fights our candidates are taking on. And they’re doing it because they come from these communities. They’ve lived the reality their neighbors are facing, and they refuse to let corporations write the rules while working families suffer.
**[Will you pitch in $5 right now to help us elect leaders like Ruwa, Jacob, Armando, and Leila standing up to corporate water exploitation and fighting for their communities?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260813_2_waterdata.zDmWII&refcode=em20260813-3869&amount=5&t=2&akid=3869%2E587540%2EXFl6PD)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
This is what happens when you put clueless jackasses in charge
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Demand Trump and Hegseth Help Sailors Aboard USS Abraham Lincoln](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71c458cd-e8e4-4c97-ac89-bbce68e0b226/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Shortages of WATER and FOOD? Are you ****ing kidding me? ([Go to Petition](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta9264e9e-377d-4f78-80df-0bbe39364458/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) | [See Other Actions](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38d65231-6ad7-4699-b287-3f583f231d12/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) The USS Abraham Lincoln has been at sea for more than 260 days, far longer than typical, [without any apparent plan to bring the sailors home or relieve the carrier](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47f1d6d5-ff71-4aa5-bde2-74f2662292d8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). For most of that time, it has been in an active war zone. **And now it is running desperately [short of basic supplies](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8f4755d-fd95-44d4-a41f-f97f27b0ee98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), including food, and sailors are battling water contamination, horrific plumbing issues, and rapidly worsening mental health conditions.** Some have even started jumping off the ship, preferring death to this nightmare. **WTF? How are we letting this happen? What the hell are Trump and Hegseth doing that is more important than sending help for these sailors?** This is the kind of thing that happens when you put clueless, incompetent jackasses in charge. | [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/124032?t=6&akid=27598%2E878179%2Eob8WWI) Hi there,

When Peggy asked me to reach out to you today, I said, “Of course!”

I’ve known Peggy for a long time. We both grew up in St. Louis Park (not at the same time — she’s young, and I’m old). Raised by a single mom (her, not me), Peggy understands the vital role federal programs play in supporting working families. From Section 8 housing vouchers to health insurance and child care assistance, she knows firsthand how these resources can transform lives.

Peggy’s credentials are impressive: currently serving as Minnesota’s Lieutenant Governor, she's the highest-ranking Native American woman ever elected to executive office in our country. Oh, and in case you’re wondering — yes, Peggy will be the first Native American woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate.

**She also refuses to take a cent of corporate PAC money, because she won’t be a puppet for corporate interests.**

While some in Washington avoid their constituents, Peggy is front and center, engaging with Minnesotans, hearing their concerns, and bringing people together. She doesn’t just want to fight Trump and his allies; she’s ready to lead and deliver concrete accomplishments for folks like she’s done in Minnesota over and over again.

That shows just how much your donation can have an impact.[Convince one voter >>](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._GP0iI5g)Thanks for taking the time to read this. I'm so grateful for your support.-Jace YarbroughSent from my iPhone

According to the Detroit News, Eli Savit chose not to bring charges after emergency workers found approximately 500 pounds of illegally trafficked marijuana in a trailer after a fire in Ypsilanti Township last year.
When a Washtenaw County sheriff's deputy contacted my opponent's office about the discovery, he was informed that the county prosecutor's office was "not going to prosecute anything related to marijuana" according to the deputy's report.
We're not talking about a little bit of marijuana for recreational purposes here. Law enforcement found 500 pounds, a large amount clearly meant to be trafficked. The Detroit News reported that this amount of marijuana would be valued around $328,000 according to the average wholesale price tracked by the state.
Almost a month after the discovery, the 500 pounds were burned at a Michigan State Police burn field.
There was no investigation, no charges were brought, and evidence was destroyed.
Refusing to prosecute illegal drug trafficking undermines our legal market, the revenue our state budget depends on, and hurts consumers. It also puts Michiganders at risk of consuming a product laced with other toxic substances or narcotics.
Whether it's psychedelic drugs, prostitution, or the other crimes he declines to prosecute, there are consequences to Eli Savit's record of refusing to enforce the law.
Michiganders need an Attorney General who takes being the state's top cop seriously. It is not a prosecutor's job to create law or pick and choose which laws they will enforce.
It's a prosecutor's job to enforce the law.
Michigan will become a dangerous place if my opponent is elected. We can't allow that to happen. I ask you to help us win this campaign to protect Michigan families and communities.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

**[Mode Mobile](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlc1yFyFjyp9Oo_VrYBhAuR18de_FdTasY6q3mUydZSD1clAPpAUpQiofs5YXAqi741YUEN58zLaMHnVubsLS55Wj1C9llcHeLvcHYn4mA)** has created technology that turns idle phone time into passive income.
Their EarnPhone has already helped users save and earn over $1B, driving the company's growth to an impressive 32,481%.

✓ Simple business models (Mode pays users for phone usage) ✓ Strong user base (490M+ users and growing) ✓ Proven revenue ($115M+ and climbing) ✓ Market leadership (#1 fastest-growing software company in 2023 - Deloitte)

## New Carrier Heads to Mideast to Relieve USS Lincoln
The Navy is sending a fresh aircraft carrier to the Middle East to [replace the _USS Abraham Lincoln_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR0WYBbYgmIbS7fY2yadNYHxeiKMV8CulbePnJ8nSDPNSEfnOy_X6QqUKN_-w4q-zduUca8JW8MyAZVQYG4BSiEsbVspItRWJiWU4cJxqScIjZ44aeiinxEVDh16aZ2xQrqT6xYv7SCdPgljbIzOCDWDmjUMxoIZQoCO_JEnnNRSCC1db87RvkkIxtkAZ5RMC4zUttK_b5TbgnP62J5Y-rCtXfJLa_fKhgtTI1Pjvu_9WvPxY2rEzB-VqfFgMTU-vg-vmCPlG58L1oX_QvmPlLeNrxRjQn54OawUORXIfIfCaytAmakRCr9cFKj4-q8rPt53SomqsUyL2wqUvuq1P6769OozAAD__xDAjcs), whose 5,000 sailors have logged more than 250 straight days at sea supporting the Iran war, with no port call in 200 days. The deployment drew Senate scrutiny after families told Navy leadership that several sailors had [tried to jump overboard](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU9jMrdsQ4MJCDYhm003RNV20dTI2Gy56FHP6VfMFTYr1Zee_vt_PpYPoET5-Rt2nGQtS8avmlAEeQHiwLBKAGZClrJTRKjCizOu18Zr2y0QhF64dNDEaUV02DY42cH3g7H-7pttGkcMvu_baEO74nBfxzuE4f4w46MNrjMNTRfPeNtZYzrrb_0Yh4eF0PshwIhWdQYjSeHbZ6EsG67pXV7It1D2Jk2byFFV-0u5Wbk5v49S5YqUmy-wcrPxys22VW4-q74MlZsPzALPkvXfk76_MWp4lFN0KDmSUMn1egBHfdbrZNhg14lyKClrWAVZMx6Fpeqy6gqUClct_Kb81FL057kf-mr5Q1FubniKxxelRLUfVGeeO1D6UZD_XP41uX8BAAD__189m94) in recent months. Navy officials deny that suicide attempts have increased. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth says conditions aboard have been "[completely misrepresented](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0RACMYFxTbusu2WFoZHeCsMFrxJlL8fZX5h6ivdo3P-3be7x4L18dcf4Ci1rcJrFCCCvnnsoftEwfeO0KkdGMEP6psSynBhudSbD4RP2LSfoksACq4TODlbMwtpb3bKbkk3f9XLrmc977ck0iIiGCkgQTDWignd509YqaUQWtqLWeK8Sx-MnYNfQDItICK1fvnfsFKGVN7tCf0S2jEVl4nOwa5_mFqZWilDxlI-G1Pr2QqGN1NrhAR1AFOrEcqKRfITCHiGxwDK_GsM7vfusz94wRpaqTy0GpGw1cEPjLEA_9gztU7dxfOFpeAwM9PicXj8AU70y4ZPp74DAAD__70ch-c)." He told the media, _"I have more respect and gratitude for those sailors than anybody."_ Officials say the carrier swap was planned before the complaints. The blockade of Iran grinds on even as Washington and Tehran [exchange messages](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD2P3CAQ_TW4YzWAF7OFi0iRpRSXNqU1C2N7IgwrmNtL_n20V6W_9j29z19v6xty5rL_xJNm2epa6KNnEqG2IrfYcJOIrTE1qScnwi5ttWC9hqDNuGIUftI64pDmjciSG2g2U_ATmHANwzEnCJNzMXoL40gx3WGCBN5uzrqbt37g-eUHwYwGYDTh4m9puhuMPkwRb2TUCJRYarv8rlzkoC3_rU9ql1jPIc-HyKMr903ZRdkF7_G14cUpu_woQq2gcC2YlV0yP0m_PxIKdWUXblj0_5gutFfhT0HX712f1Dvu1DX9iQeWnZIWOhqWV5pbOCn33bjrFcINYGhzenxwztz9pEbYT-T82VK-eO5ztv8CAAD__yu7j_4) about possible negotiations.
## Flock Sets New Safeguards in Face of Backlash

## Appeals Court Restores Texas Mail-Ballot Rules
A federal appeals court on Wednesday [restored Texas' requirement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvSpCAUhJ8GM6a4CRoQbGI2m25oHeE4UoWDC2dub_-X8wp_3N1fdfe_63yFlNP99hd29PRey3zHV8tIhHXe0m1rYSslr6XQAjkfGT5Y46yEslwMXJoZAqUnzga66BcRR9mhl26wTvRa627z_Qg2GLm4Pjhw2oCwqKLRAD2O4IYu-RMnBmmkFEqKi1vkOEBcIqyrFb1iRmBMVOqFNiR8Q1vzpzyxXkLZu-w3oqMx_YepiakJliD1qTA1NSr1w9T0DfEdUubnjEI8RV7x_yNV3PFOjVc8vRj5ihErZA7HgZAbD-VRialJjtYpKwempq76eLxSzqlZx4y4neBvF_rth0-vfgIAAP__SROH6A) that mail voters provide an ID number matching state records. The 5th Circuit reversed a district judge who struck down nine provisions of Senate Bill 1 in March 2025, ruling they violated the Americans with Disabilities Act. The 2021 law also requires anyone assisting a voter to swear that no coercion occurred. Voto Latino, LULAC Texas, and two other groups that sued called the law "draconian" and argued it [falls hardest on older Texans](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ugzAUxfGngc3IXzFk8NCFLV07ImNf4ysZnJobSN6-Sl6h-1-_I52f23RzmHFbvt0Klp6xTBucewYiqFPCJe0-lZJjKTS7nO_ZvaCGSXJpGB-Y0JPzhAdM2rXBzjxcRQtW9IPp-UUp1SartPYXGIzpezMEL5RXRvnZhVk738-iRfvm-CC0EFwK3vWzuA4uzMHFaPhFNppDQCq1owQET7fH_CoH1M6Xtc02Ed33Rn01cmzkeJ5nF8tTmlQeO5XtHTVyhAyesGyNHCNGSsxj9Q8k9gHZ6jAz3NhRCLeFYWAVfh9YYYWN9rbacD8xZ9xN32i-vPPPOv33tcPKvwAAAP__L86FjQ) and people of color. The panel found most plaintiffs lacked standing to sue. "_None of these members has shown a 'substantial risk' of disenfranchisement,_ " the court wrote. Judge Andrew Oldham wrote that mail ballots have "long been established" as prone to fraud, and noted rejections tied to ID errors fell from 11% to 2.7%. Attorney General Ken Paxton called the ruling a "major victory."

| | **Brent Fell to $87.92, Snapping a Six-Day Advance, as Trump Declared the US Has ‘Total Control’ Over Hormuz — Even as Talks Stay Deadlocked and Sanctions Expand. Here Is Why the Pullback Is Consolidation, Not Resolution.**
---
| | The oil market’s momentum broke today. Brent crude fell toward $88, settling at $87.92 — down 1.19% — snapping a six-day advance as investors reassessed the prospects of any deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. **The catalyst was a shift in tone from the White House: President Trump declared the US had ‘total control’ over the waterway, recasting the standoff from a negotiation into an assertion of dominance even as talks remained deadlocked.** Over the past month, Brent has still risen 3.76%, and stands 31.53% higher than a year ago.
---
| | For your portfolio, the ‘total control’ framing cuts two ways. A US claim of total control implies Washington believes it can manage the chokepoint militarily without an Iranian deal — which, if true, would eventually ease the supply premium. **But the administration is simultaneously moving toward greater economic pressure — expanding sanctions and enforcing the blockade to curb Iranian exports — because the military campaign has so far failed to force the regime to capitulate.** Dominance claimed but capitulation not achieved is the contradiction the market is pricing. For the American investor at or near retirement, today’s modest pullback should not be mistaken for a resolution: the six-day rally reflected genuine supply anxiety, and one soft day on rhetoric does not reverse it. Brent has established a higher range in the mid-to-high $80s, and today’s dip is consolidation within it. Until a concrete de-escalation or genuine deal, the elevated energy premium keeps feeding the inflation and rate dynamics that drive your portfolio.
---

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Warren Buffett famously said: "If you don't find a way to make money while you sleep, you will work until you die." | The answer may already be sitting on your nightstand... has created technology that turns idle phone time into passive income. | | **The IEA Says the Global Market Faces a 1.8-Million-Barrel Daily Shortfall. The Same Week, US Inventories Rose 17.4 Million Barrels. Reconciling the Two Reveals a Partial Buffer for the American Consumer.**
---
| | Two data points this week appear to contradict each other, and reconciling them is the key to where oil goes next. The IEA’s monthly report indicated the global oil market faces a shortfall of 1.8 million barrels a day this quarter as the Middle East conflict continues. **Yet in the same window, US EIA data showed American crude inventories rose by 17.4 million barrels last week — their largest weekly build since early 2023.** A global deficit and a surging US stockpile at the same time is a genuine puzzle.
---
| | For your household, the reconciliation lies in geography. The global 1.8-million-barrel deficit is driven by the Middle East — Hormuz constriction, Saudi diversions, curbed Iranian exports — which hits the seaborne crude Asian and European refiners depend on. **The US, the world’s largest oil producer, is relatively insulated; the 17.4-million-barrel build reflects strong domestic production meeting softer demand as high pump prices and a weakening consumer curb US gasoline use.** The global market is short where the war cut supply off, while America accumulates barrels it cannot easily ship into the disrupted market. For the American investor, the split has a reassuring implication: ample domestic supply should put downward pressure on US gasoline and heating costs relative to the global Brent price — a partial buffer against the worst of the shock. Watch the gap between Brent and US WTI: a widening spread confirms American consumers are partly shielded from the global shortfall.
---
| | Sources: Trading Economics / IEA, EIA, August 13, 2026 · CNBC, August 11, 2026 · Al Jazeera, August 10, 2026

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. name: Power the Polls
subject: Still on the fence? Here's what being a poll worker is really like
body:
You’re getting this message from [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4508?t=1001&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]Power the Polls because you signed up
to learn about serving as a poll worker. If you no longer wish to hear
from us, [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9123.934366.slI3JW&t=1002&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]please unsubscribe here. Marking emails as spam can affect our
ability to reach others with important information.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=1003&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ][IMG]

Hey Peter—

As we wrap up [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4928?t=1004&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]National Poll Worker Recruitment Week, some folks are
still on the fence about signing up, and we get it – "poll worker" can
sound like a bigger commitment than it actually is. So here's what it's
really like, from people who've done it:

“This experience gave me a glimmer of hope that in the long run we will
be okay. Everyone should volunteer at their polling place at least once
in their lives.” - Josh

“It's always rewarding to be there, because one, you don't honestly get
a lot of people that volunteer to work, and so showing up, and knowing
that sometimes I've been one of three people to work a polling location,
but knowing if we didn't show up, then there wouldn't be a place for
someone to go vote. And so that was rewarding for me” - Demethra

“Working at a local polling place was connective, empowering, and a
deeply humanizing experience. I come away humbled and excited to do more
to help my local community be empowered!” - Elizabeth

Nationwide, most poll workers say they'd do it again and it's one of the
most direct ways to support your community on Election Day.

What actually happens after you sign up:

1. Your application goes to your local elections office for review.
2. If you're selected, you'll get scheduled for a short training session,
no previous experience needed.
3. You'll receive your polling place assignment and everything you need
to know before Election Day.

That's it. No surprises, no guesswork. [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4928?t=1005&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]Sign up now at
powerthepolls.org.

You don't need experience, just a few minutes for the application and a
willingness to show up.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4927?t=1006&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]Start my Application

Thanks,

The Power the Polls Team

P.S. Since your application goes straight to your local elections office,
we don't always know if you've finished, started training, or decided the
timing isn't right. [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2026_poll_worker_status_survey/?t=1007&akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW ]Take two minutes to update us on your application
status so we can send you the more useful information.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9123%2E934366%2EslI3JW

name: Susan Collins
subject: Maine taught me how to fight for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Collins for Senator
body:
Insulin costs. Alzheimer's research. Maine values. Will you stand with me?

Insulin costs. Alzheimer's research. Maine values. Will you stand with me?
| [](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---
Peter,I grew up in Aroostook County, Maine - as far north as you can go and still be in the continuous United States. It's a place where people work with their hands, look out for their neighbors, and don't expect anyone to hand them anything.That's the Maine I carry with me every single day in Washington.It's why, when I became Chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee, one of the most powerful posts in the entire Senate, I didn't forget where I came from. I use that gavel to fight for the things that actually matter to families like the ones I grew up with:
---
* Capping the cost of insulin so no Mainer living with diabetes has to choose between medication and groceries.
* Fighting for real funding for Alzheimer's research, because I've seen what this disease does to families, and I refuse to look away.
* Delivering for our veterans, our farmers, our fishermen, and our small towns that Washington so often forgets.

---
I didn't take the easy path to get here, and I'm not taking the easy path now. But I can't do this alone.Maine gave me everything. Now I need you to stand up for Maine.[Can I count on you to please chip in today and help me keep fighting for the people who raised me?](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---
| [STAND WITH ME](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---
| [STAND UP FOR MAINE](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---

A story for you
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2494%2E135344%2Ej0-1WH)

I want to share a story with you about a man elected to office on the promise of lowering costs ... and instead ushering in an era of increased corruption and inflation.
No, the man isn't Donald Trump.
His name is Viktor Orban in Hungary, and his defeat earlier this year demonstrates the way you push back against authoritarians is not by sitting on our hands -- it's by pushing back every day.

Elissa Slotkin

In late June, Ohio Democrat gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton said she was against men in women's sports, claiming the issue was settled law in Ohio.

Loomer Unleashed has uncovered that Acton has received donations from powerful Ohio Democrat legislators, like Ohio Senate Democrat Leader Nickie J. Antonio, who led the charge against Ohio House Bill 68, which banned child mutilation and men in women's sports. Acton is also supported by organizations like Equality Ohio, which opposed House Bill 68.
Acton's record casts doubt on whether she would try to change Ohio's laws to allow men in women's sports and child mutilation in the Buckeye State, despite the recent US Supreme Court ruling that upheld state rights to ban men from competing in women's sports.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8122bd0-d80d-4aa9-98af-f1a4c6aa81b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The language of Ohio House Bill 68, now Ohio law, reads clearly on what is banned in the Buckeye State. The bill summary reads:
> _" To enact the Saving Ohio Adolescents from Experimentation (SAFE) Act regarding gender transition services for minors, and to enact the Save Women's Sports Act to require schools, state institutions of higher education, and private colleges to designate separate single-sex teams and sports for each sex."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dcd1d77-c0ef-4d99-b8e7-5efbd3917df1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ohio campaign finance records reveal Friends of Nickie J. Antonio, the campaign committee associated with Ohio Democrat Senate Leader Nickie J. Antonio, donated to Amy Acton's gubernatorial campaign in 2025.
During the fight to enact House Bill 68 into law, Antonio led the charge in the Ohio Senate to obstruct the measure. Antonio even sent out a letter to her colleagues informing them just how much she supports child mutilation and men in women's sports.
Part of the letter reads:
> _" This bill, should it pass, portends dire consequences that would affect families in Ohio with transgender children receiving medical care. Because this bill includes a ban on gender-affirming care for transgender minors, even with parental consent, families would also be denied mental health care and support for their children. This action would jeopardize the health and well-being of those currently under a physician's care by requiring an abrupt legislative, rather than a medically prescribed, end to their treatment."_
The letter continues:
> _" To quote a letter from the Healthcare Provider Community (see attached): 'This bill takes away the rights of parents and creates a situation where their children will no longer receive the care that they need and that their parents support. Parents of transgender children face an extraordinarily difficult situation, as do their kids. These parents have the ultimate responsibility to care for their children, and Sub HB 68 undermines that obligation.'"_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e5dea54-d478-4364-8dff-3a218e51cddb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Senate Democrat Leader Antonio is not the only pro-child-mutilation Ohio lawmaker who is financially supporting Acton. Campaign finance records also show Friends of Anita Somani, the campaign committee associated with Ohio state Rep. Anita Somani, donated to Acton in 2025.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..alNuNkCxk906ZrmQmksEKPOdK_JhYZNH7KMGaFcNn64?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=211178399)
Like her Ohio Senate Democrat colleague Antonio, Somani also released a statement regarding House Bill 68 that showed her support for child mutilation and men in women's sports. Part of the statement reads:
> _" House Republicans continue to silence the voices of Ohioans by passing legislation that disregards evidence-based medicine and denies LGBTQ+ youth the ability to be their true, authentic selves. House Bill 68 bans doctors from providing any type of gender-affirming care for minors in Ohio, including the use of puberty blockers and hormone therapy."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e175eafb-2735-4649-9139-2d79f6e6685a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ohio State Rep. Casey Weinstein also donated to Amy Acton's gubernatorial campaign in 2025. Weinstein criticized HB 68 as an attack on the trans community in a statement that read:
> _" I strongly oppose recent anti-transgender and discriminatory bills like the Anti-Trans Sports Ban (House Bill 6), the Ban on Gender Affirming Care (HB 68), and the Bathroom Discrimination Act (HB 183), and all pieces of legislation which would further stigmatize and discriminate against already marginalized queer Ohioans."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18f3e5c8-1870-47a7-a308-138ec4a5386d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Amy Acton has an A rating with Equality Ohio, a pro-Trans and radical left organization, while her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy has an F rating. Equality Ohio, which worked to kill Ohio House Bill 68, released a statement reading:
> _" What is HB 68?: We're asking you to submit a survey, telling us about your experiences with youth sports or gender affirming care in Ohio. You can talk about their importance to your own life or simply a statement stating why you support transgender dignity in Ohio. You can do this as an individual, family, group of friends, or organization."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b636b78c-b493-433e-8861-e5b75d1fbb10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/214e9528-4563-4024-9b42-ec2825e4876e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kamala Harris has also sent fundraising emails on behalf of Acton. In the White House, Harris worked with Joe Biden to fight for men in women's sports and advocated for "trans kids".
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f0943336-52b1-4f4d-94f9-2eea72deda21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The facts make it clear that Acton, if elected, would work with Democrats to change Ohio's laws to allow for child mutilation and men in women's sports, making her "settled law" statements ring quite hollow when you follow the money.

Dear Peter,

CNBC just named the "best place to live in America" - and for the fifth year in a row, _it 's Vermont_.

Their reasoning? **Vermont was the first state in the nation to enshrine abortion in its constitution, and CNBC gave it a perfect score, listing zero weaknesses.**

Minnesota came in at number four, and **CNBC praised Gov. Tim Walz (D)** for enshrining abortion into state law with his so-called "Protect Reproductive Options Act."

What they left out: Walz's long record of letting babies born alive after botched abortions be left to die.

You can't make this stuff up! And it just goes to show why our work at Students for Life Action is needed now more than ever before.

Peter, today marks the 91st anniversary of the Social Security Act being signed into law — creating a program nearly 70 million Americans rely on, including more than 130,000 right here in our district.

For nearly a century, this program has been fulfilling the promise made to seniors that after a lifetime of working hard and paying taxes, you can retire with dignity and the benefits you’ve earned.

That promise is what the Trump administration and its Republican majorities have been working relentlessly to break: cutting staff, closing Social Security field offices, restricting services, making it nearly impossible for seniors to receive the benefits that they have earned. They’ve even talked openly about privatizing it, and Mike Johnson has put it on the chopping block in the next Congress.

It’s just plain wrong, and every single American deserves better.

**I will keep fighting to protect and strengthen Social Security for everyone who relies on it now and for all the future generations to come.**

clean_body: | | | | = Peter, today marks the 91st anniversary of the Social Security Act being signed into law — creating a program nearly 70 million Americans rely on, including more than 130,000 right here in our district. For nearly a century, this program has been fulfilling the promise made to seniors that after a lifetime of working hard and paying taxes, you can retire with dignity and the benefits you’ve earned. That promise is what the Trump administration and its Republican majorities have been working relentlessly to break: cutting staff, closing Social Security field offices, restricting services, making it nearly impossible for seniors to receive the benefits that they have earned. They’ve even talked openly about privatizing it, and Mike Johnson has put it on the chopping block in the next Congress. It’s just plain wrong, and every single American deserves better. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. Dear Patriot,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) I want to teach you something the vote thieves hope you never learn: exactly how they do it. Because once you see the trick, you can't unsee it. And this fall, thousands of trained eyes are going to be watching for it — thanks to patriots like you. **[Chip in $35 to put another pair in the field.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Step one: find someone desperate. On Skid Row, our hidden cameras filmed operatives working the sidewalks — offering cash, food, even drugs to people who had nothing. Two dollars was the going rate. Step two: hand them a name that isn't theirs. We filmed a circulator telling one of them: "I'm giving you a new name." Where did the names come from? A database of real, registered voters — real people, whose signatures were forged by strangers. Step three: turn the forgery into paper. The fake signature goes on a petition or a registration form. The form goes to the state. And somewhere across town, a real voter's voice has been stolen — and he won't find out until it's too late. Twenty-eight times, our cameras caught this happening. And when the feds filed charges, the scheme kept right on running — in broad daylight. Here's the good news: every step of that trick is visible. The cash handoff. The clipboard. The coaching. You just need someone standing there with a camera. That's what our volunteers are training for right now — **[and every one of them needs a sponsor.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** **[SPONSOR A VOLUNTEER JOURNALIST — CHIP IN $35 NOW](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** You fund the mission. My team takes the risks. You see the results — the footage, the confessions, the changed laws. In 2012, one camera in New Hampshire helped change a state's voting laws. Now imagine dozens of cameras, in dozens of cities, all trained to spot the same three steps. That's what your gift builds. # ReproMatters

---|---
| Peter—

Maria Rojas is a Texas midwife who provided vital prenatal, postpartum, and birthing care for fifteen years. Maria and her staff were trusted caregivers, primarily serving low-income, uninsured, Spanish-speaking people -- communities that face immense barriers to access the health care they need.

All that changed last year, when Maria was slammed with trumped-up criminal and civil charges. Texas’s attorney general, Ken Paxton, accused her of providing abortions in violation of the state’s total abortion ban and practicing medicine without a license.

Last month, the Center secured a victory for Maria when an appeals court found that the state had produced no evidence to support the civil charges against her.

But the state’s baseless attack has upended Maria’s life. She was forced to close her three clinics, and her midwifery license was suspended. She was held in jail for 10 days until an exorbitant $1.4 million bond was posted, and she was required to wear an ankle monitor. She is also facing separate, related criminal charges, for which she could face up to life in prison if found guilty.

What’s more, hundreds of families that relied on Maria’s clinics have been left without their health care provider and access to their health records and test results, forcing them to find care elsewhere if they can.

In a state with an abysmal maternal mortality rate, the government should be seeking to expand access to reproductive health care, especially for underserved communities. Instead, the anti-abortion zealots in the Texas attorney general’s office have arrested ten other people affiliated with Maria’s clinics, calling them a “cabal of abortion-loving radicals” and charging most of them with practicing medicine without a license.

We will keep fighting for justice for Maria and other reproductive health care providers who are facing unfounded legal attacks. We are committed to ensuring that people who have dedicated their lives and careers to serving patients can continue to provide lawful, urgently needed care.

The Repro Rights Team

subject: URGENT: CONTACT YOUR REPS, GET DATA CENTERS ON THE AGENDA
body:
The North Dakota Legislative Management Committee meets Monday, August 17, at 10:00 a.m. in the Roughrider Room at the State Capitol in Bismarck.

This meeting is critical.

The committee will consider Sen. Tim Mathern's proposed bills addressing data center development:
\- A one-year statewide moratorium on new data center permits
\- A prohibition on non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) signed by public officials regarding data centers

If you want these issues heard during the Special Session, HERE'S HOW YOU CAN TAKE ACTION:

1\. Contact your legislators before Monday.
Visit [this link](https://actionnetwork.org/letters/data-center-moratorium-3?source=direct_link&) to contact your legislator directly about the upcoming Special Session.

2\. Contact members of the Legislative Management Committee before Monday.
Visit [this link](https://share.google/9WlxsosucClHI6xVs) to contact members of the LMC (note Rep. Zac Ista will be replaced by Sen. Ryan Braunberger and Sen. Josh Boschee is stepping down)

3\. Share this information before Monday.
Your voice matters – but so does the collective voice of North Dakotans.

Don't wait until after the decision is made. Make your voice heard before Monday’s meeting.
Please share this widely and encourage your family, friends, neighbors, farmers, ranchers, and communities to get involved.

Thank you,

Vern

\--

Vern Thompson
Candidate for ND Agriculture Commissioner
[thompson4nd@gmail.com](mailto:thompson4nd@gmail.com)
701-400-6767

Peter, last month Mariannette Miller-Meeks posted that she was "committed to protecting and strengthening Social Security."

But actions speak louder than social media, and her actions tell us that **Miller-Meeks is a dangerous threat to the future of Social Security _and_ Medicare.**

She has supported privatizing both Social Security and Medicare, which would put at risk the guaranteed benefits seniors have paid into. She blamed the high cost of health care on Medicare. She has even called for raising the retirement age for Social Security. Worse, she voted _against_ allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower drug prices, _against_ capping seniors' out-of-pocket drug expenses, and _against_ capping the cost of insulin at $35 per month for seniors on Medicare.

Are you outraged? [**Christina is, and she needs your help to go to Congress and actually protect and strengthen the programs our communities depend on. Will you make a donation to help us reach our campaign's $10,000 mid-month goal?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137213650/640043511/-2016015222?refcode=em26_260814_MM1_fnd_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260814_MM1_fnd_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=dfb9546f-e897-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmI5NTQ2Zi1lODk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cq9GYfrL2iKXZYjblx6cPC9CfPB3NvDG8zFsCgIRgvA=)

Now here's what real commitment looks like. In Congress, Christina will:

body:
Allow me to let you in on a little secret.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Marrying Gina Hinojosa 27 years ago today was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. She’s still my favorite person, no matter how much older we get. Gina has been a devoted partner and an unmatched mother to our kids. And her career in public service inspires us all to always fight for what we believe in every day.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260814_1_anniv.LKZlhz&refcode=em20260814-1826&amount=5&t=1&akid=1826%2E299639%2EZ6xYLw)
Allow me to let you in on a little secret. When I heard that Gina was polling within one point of Greg Abbott, I was ecstatic — but I wasn’t surprised. I’ve known Gina has what it takes to win this thing from day one. **She is the leader Texas needs.** And if we can get her message out there, I’m sure she’s going to win in November.
Gina doesn’t have her opponent’s mega-millions, but she doesn’t need them. She just needs enough of us who believe in a brighter future for Texas to support her and ensure her campaign hits each and every one of its fundraising goals. It’s that simple, Peter. If Gina’s fundraising stays on track, she can run the campaign that finally defeats Abbott and ends more than a decade of failed leadership in Texas.
Today is a special day for us. But rest assured that Gina isn’t taking a break. She’s on the campaign trail talking to voters about what’s at stake in this critical election.
That’s why I want to do something today to remind her that we all have her back.
**[Can you help mark this special occasion with a $5 donation now? We’re so close to taking back Texas — and Gina’s working as hard as she can to win.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260814_1_anniv.LKZlhz&refcode=em20260814-1826&amount=5&t=2&akid=1826%2E299639%2EZ6xYLw)**

Thank you for supporting Gina every day, but especially today.
John Donisi
Husband, teammate, and proud Texan

body:
Dear Friend,

This September, the New Hampshire Republican Party is proud to host TWO major events during one incredible week.

We will start the week off with our historic Unity Breakfast where we will support and celebrate our nominees as we head into our November midterm election. It is a tradition you won’t want to miss!

We will end the week with another tradition: the Amos Tuck Dinner. This year, I am excited to announce that Senator Rick Scott will be our special guest!

We are building the momentum we need to win — and we want YOU to be part of it.

Don't miss your chance to join fellow Republicans, elected officials, candidates, grassroots activists, and supporters for what will be an unforgettable week for the New Hampshire Republican Party.

clean_body: Dear Friend, This September, the New Hampshire Republican Party is proud to host TWO major events during one incredible week. We will start the week off with our historic Unity Breakfast where we will support and celebrate our nominees as we head into our November midterm election. It is a tradition you won’t want to miss! We will end the week with another tradition: the Amos Tuck Dinner. This year, I am excited to announce that Senator Rick Scott will be our special guest! We are building the momentum we need to win — and we want YOU to be part of it. Don't miss your chance to join fellow Republicans, elected officials, candidates, grassroots activists, and supporters for what will be an unforgettable week for the New Hampshire Republican Party. Peter,
The list of MAGA Republicans' unfulfilled promises grows every day. The gold-covered scam is happening right before our eyes.
Gas costs at least $4.00/gallon because of the war in Iran. Our grocery shelves are empty as recall after recall from parasites and dangerous bacteria thanks to RFK Jr's regulatory nightmares. Data centers and cuts to clean energy tax programs have raised our energy costs and are damaging our environment.
MAGA Republicans like Mike Johnson campaigned on the promise to make life easier for working people, but instead have done the exact opposite. When it comes to Trump's reckless spending on golden monuments, reflecting pool makeovers, and the Iran War, they're happy to deliver.

| During a time when Americans can't afford food, healthcare, groceries, or gas, we're living through Trump's golden age. For us? We're living through MAGA Republicans' golden hoax.
While my neighbors are struggling to put food on their table, Mike Johnson is standing by as Trump puts a fake golden sheen on our economy:

* When millions of Americans lost healthcare coverage, the Big Ugly Bill gave billions to rebuilding the border wall.

* When Trump's petty tariffs raised the cost of everything from new Nikes to lunchboxes, billion-dollar corporations got their money back, not the people who paid them.

* When gas prices hit a record high because of the Iran War, Mike Johnson wants to give Trump billions more to keep the unconstitutional conflict going.

MAGA Republicans have no problem coughing up the cash for Trump, but when it comes to you and me, they slam the door shut.
It doesn't matter how many statues they cover in gold. This is all one big golden hoax that MAGA Republicans will continue until we stop them.
I'm Conrad Cable. I'm a proud Democrat and a Louisiana farmer. I know what it's like to lose health insurance and barely fill up my gas tank. MAGA Mike Johnson doesn't.
Louisiana's 4th deserves someone who understands the value of the dollar -- not someone who gives Donald Trump a pot of gold while we pay the price. body:
If you’re fed up with chaos in Washington, please read this message.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107454?refcode=em20260814-10788&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10788%2E614464%2EyoGRZl)
Hi, Peter,
I’m Adam Hamilton, and I am the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kansas. Before I invite you to **[support my grassroots campaign by splitting a gift between myself and Heartland Patriots,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107454?refcode=em20260814-10788&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10788%2E614464%2EyoGRZl)** I’d like to share a bit about who I am and why I decided to run.
I’m a husband to my high school sweetheart and best friend, LaVon, a father of two remarkable daughters and a proud grandfather. I’ve been a pastor for the past 36 years, and I’m also a proud fifth-generation Kansan. I love Kansas and its people, and I love my country. **That’s why I felt called to run for the U.S. Senate.**
Washington's chaos, corruption and extremism are tearing this country apart. And we have a government in D.C. that’s making life harder for the American people.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I care about our country, because things need to change — because I know I can build bridges, bring people together to solve problems and be a champion for Kansas.**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107454?refcode=em20260814-10788&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10788%2E614464%2EyoGRZl)**
I’ve heard from people all over the state who voted for Sen. Roger Marshall six years ago and now feel he’s not listening to them — people who have met with him and felt unseen or dismissed by the man they elected to represent them. I believe we can and must do better.
**That work begins in earnest now, and if you agree that what’s going on in our country is unacceptable, then I need you with me. body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter, I wanted to personally thank you for joining our campaign.
I grew up in Auburn in a blue-collar family. My dad spent 41 years working as a correctional officer. My mom is a nurse who cares for Alzheimer’s patients. I worked multiple jobs to put myself through school, became the first person in my family to earn a four-year degree, and spent years paying off my student loans.
_I know what it means to work hard, do everything right, and still wonder why it keeps getting harder to get ahead._
**That is why I’m running for Congress: to lower costs, protect our communities, defend our farmers and small businesses, and make Central New York a place where our children can build their futures.**
But this campaign doesn't just belong to me. It belongs to every New Yorker who is ready to fight for something better.
_That means you, too._
Because you joined us at the very beginning, I’m inviting you to become an official FOUNDING MEMBER of Kailee Buller for Congress.
---

We'll also be keeping you in the loop with all of the exclusive campaign-only memos and polls to keep you up-to-date on any important news the campaign receives.

Support PolitiBrawl by becoming a paid subscriber: The Department of Justice announced they are offering up to $5,000 for information that leads to the arrests of dog and animal abusers on Skid Row in response to the years-long problem. As I previously reported, Los Angeles County, and particularly Skid Row, has a massive animal abuse crisis. The abusers are typically homeless drug addicts, who use the animals to settle debts, sell, and test drugs so the users do not overdose. WATCH: "We are announcing a $5,000 reward for tips leading to the successful prosecution of defendants who have violated the federal Preventing Animal Cruelty and Torture (PACT) Act. This law criminalizes animal abuse in or affecting interstate or foreign commerce and making 'animal crush' videos that depict obscene animal abuse," First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli explained. The rampant dog abuse in Skid Row has been a problem for a long time, with California Democrats having full awareness of the problem, but taking no action to solve it and protect these dogs from the drug addicts they seem more interested in protecting instead. Spencer Pratt was the only mayoral candidate before the primaries who specifically campaigned on going after the animal abusers. Mayor Karen Bass and Council member Nithya Raman had little to say about the issue before it was national headlines. After Raman posted on X about her plans to address the crisis, despite being part of the city's government already, Pratt shared a video of when she walked out when an animal activist was speaking to the council. "Look at Nithya walking out on animal rights activist Rebecca Corry when she pleaded for help with the animal abuse in LA, reminding Raman that she has MORE power to address this on council than Mayor Bass," Pratt wrote on X. Activists who work in Skid Row have a plethora of videos and photos already, which have been shared with the DOJ since the announcement. clean_body: A J6 patriot in desperate need I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Fellow Patriot, I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Tyler was a commercial pilot for 14 years... until Joe Biden 's TSA revoked his commercial pilot's license for "suspicion of terrorism" without even being charged with a crime. As a result of his lost pilot's salary, Tyler's family business is now in bankruptcy, and he, his wife, and their four kids are in desperate need of your support. I promised Tyler Stand in the Gap could help raise the funds he needs to get his company back on track, and Fellow Patriot, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment: My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends. After President Trump's speech, I went to the Capitol. What I saw with my own eyes did not match what the news reported. On March 26, 2021, the TSA revoked my commercial pilot 's license for "suspicion of terrorism" and being a threat to the national airspace -- before I was ever charged with a crime and before any FBI interview.I spent $40,000 in legal fees. In June 2021, Allegiant fired me. Without my W-2 income, I could no longer sustain the construction company my wife and I owned. It is now in bankruptcy. We have four children. I now work 6-7 days a week in construction just to survive. I'm hoping Stand in the Gap can help us raise $25,000 to stabilize our family and our company during this bankruptcy and help us recover from the financial destruction caused by the sudden end of my aviation career. We have nowhere else to turn. Thank you for anything you can do. -- Tyler Tew Tyler's story is why we started our Fund Their Futures fundraising program, Fellow Patriot. President Trump's pardons gave these patriots back their freedom... but that did NOT give them their lives, careers, businesses, or homes back. Tyler did everything right for decades... building a wonderful career, a small business, and a loving family. It all ended WITHOUT due process ... simply because the Far-Left wanted to punish him for supporting President Trump. Your gift today will give Tyler and his family breathing room. It'll help stabilize their company and help them keep a roof over their heads. Stand with the Gap exists specifically for moments like this... to when the legal fight is over, but the fight to survive has just begun. Too often, Stand in the Gap is the for the men and women who faced political persecution and financial ruin after January 6. We exist to share the burden and make it lighter ... and your generosity is quite literally the difference between families like Tyler's losing everything. That's why I hope you'll step forward, Fellow Patriot. Even just a few dollars could make a critical difference. Thank you so much for helping them out. Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap Stand In The Gap is registered as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.
