name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Clear your record for FREE this September
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
LAST CALL: Sign the pledge to support a brighter future for working Texans
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
These last few weeks, TOP has teamed up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to promote the Willing to Fight Pledge [https://toptx.us/orn] -- a commitment to a vision and future where ALL Texans have the ability to grow and thrive.
We're only a few days from our end-of-June deadline. Can you sign the pledge today to help us reach our completed pledge goal? [https://toptx.us/orn]
It only takes a minute and your feedback provides our groups with a look at what issues matter most to you and your family.
👉🏾 Take the pledge now! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrating our communities and building fellowship this Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
TOP staff and members celebrated Juneteenth alongside community partners at events across Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio this past week. Through that celebration we honor the ancestors we stand on the shoulders of, and recommit to working tirelessly toward a future where race and class are no longer barriers to justice and opportunity in our country.
Juneteenth serves as a renewed call to unite against racial and economic injustice, so that we can chart a path toward a stronger Texas and nation that uplifts and empowers every Black person, regardless of their background or economic status. This is why we organize. This is why we are stronger together.
Taking time this summer to refuel for the second half of 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed Saturday, June 27 - Sunday, July 5, as we take time to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for a busy rest of 2026 filled with organizing and getting out the vote! You can still keep in touch with us online, though. Give us a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Get the most out of your vacation phone pics
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
Taking quality phone pics can be easier said than done! Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community this summer, utilize these easy tips [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments.
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]
Español
ÚLTIMA OPORTUNIDAD: Firma el compromiso para apoyar un futuro mejor para los trabajadores de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
En las últimas semanas, TOP se ha unido a nuestros amigos de Organizing Revival Network para promover el compromiso "Willing to Fight" [https://toptx.us/orn] (Dispuestos a Luchar): un compromiso con una visión y un futuro en los que TODOS los tejanos tengan la oportunidad de crecer y prosperar.
Estamos a pocos días de nuestra fecha límite de finales de junio. ¿Podrías firmar el compromiso hoy mismo para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestra meta? [https://toptx.us/orn]
Solo te llevará un minuto, y tu opinión nos permitirá saber qué temas son los más importantes para ti y tu familia.
👉🏾 ¡Firma el compromiso ahora! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrando a nuestras comunidades y fortaleciendo la camaradería en este Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
La semana pasada, el personal y los miembros de TOP celebraron Juneteenth junto a aliados comunitarios en eventos realizados en Houston, Dallas y San Antonio. A través de esta celebración, honramos a los ancestros sobre cuyos hombros nos apoyamos y reafirmamos nuestro compromiso de trabajar incansablemente por un futuro en el que la raza y la clase social ya no sean barreras para la justicia y las oportunidades en nuestro país.
Juneteenth representa un llamado renovado a unirnos contra la injusticia racial y económica, para así trazar el camino hacia un Texas y una nación más fuertes que impulsen y empoderen a cada persona afrodescendiente, independientemente de sus antecedentes o situación económica. Por esto nos organizamos. Por esto somos más fuertes unidos.
Dedicar tiempo este verano a recargar energías para la segunda mitad de 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Spanish%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
Las oficinas de TOP permanecerán cerradas desde el sábado 27 de junio hasta el domingo 5 de julio ; aprovecharemos este tiempo para descansar, renovar energías y prepararnos para el resto del año 2026, ¡lleno de actividades de organización y movilización del voto! Sin embargo, pueden seguir en contacto con nosotros a través de internet. Sígannos en las siguientes plataformas:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
Consejos de TOP: Sácale el máximo partido a las fotos de tus vacaciones tomadas con el móvil
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
¡Tomar fotos de calidad con el teléfono móvil es más fácil de decir que de hacer! Ya sea que viajes al extranjero, a otra parte del estado o simplemente por tu propia comunidad este verano, aprovecha estos sencillos consejos [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] para sacar el máximo provecho a las fotos de tu celular y capturar esos momentos especiale s.

### **Calling all Volunteers
to Help Team Tad Jude!**

---
We Won the Primary — Now Let’s Get to Work!

Hello!

Thank you, volunteers, for everything you’ve done for our campaign so far! **You helped us win the Republican Primary for Minnesota Secretary of State!** We truly appreciate the time, energy, and support you’ve given.

Now it’s time to keep the momentum going and get ready for November, when we take on Steve Simon. We have a couple of immediate volunteer needs and would love your help!
**
1\. STATE FAIR PREP
**
Tad will have his **own booth at the Minnesota State Fair** , and we have some simple assembly projects to prepare materials for the fair.

We’ll be gathering at our house during these times. Come for a few hours—or stay longer. Whatever works for you!

**Sunday, 8/16:** 1:00 PM–8:00 PM
**Monday, 8/17:** 10:00 AM–8:00 PM
**Tuesday, 8/18:** 10:00 AM–8:00 PM
**Wednesday, 8/19:** 10:00 AM–8:00 PM

🍕 Food and beverages will be provided!

If none of those times work for you, **let Jackie know**. We can find another time that works.
**
2\. DELIVERIES**

We’re getting signs and campaign materials out to counties and Victory offices across Minnesota, and we need **drivers to help with deliveries**.

If you have some time and are willing to make a delivery, let Jackie know. Every trip helps!
**
HOW TO HELP**

**Contact Jackie Jude and let her know how you’d like to help:
**
📱 **612-750-9057
**📧 [**jackie@tadjudeforsos.com
**](mailto:jackie@tadjudeforsos.com)
When you reach out, let Jackie know **what days/times work for you** and whether you’re interested in helping with State Fair preparation, deliveries, or both.

Thank you again for everything you’ve done to get us here. **We won the primary because of you—and now we have a November election to win!
**
More volunteer opportunities are coming, so stay tuned!

Thank you!

As a mom, back to school season has always been such a special time for me. It makes me think about not just the future of my children, but the future of every Texas kid from Amarillo to Galveston. That strong sense of responsibility is what made me launch my first ever campaign.
I never planned to run for office. I was compelled to. In 2012, state budget cuts threatened to close my son's elementary school. Instead of waiting to see what happens, I immediately chose to fight. I organized parents, ran for our local school board, and thankfully -- I won. We kept my son's school open, along with every other public school in the district.
But unfortunately, the state of education in Texas is only getting worse -- not better.
Since Greg Abbott took office, the problem of underfunded schools has only continued. The results: 150 schools are closing and 150 school districts have moved to four-day weeks. Abbott has taken millions from donors and handed out vendor contracts all while taking dollars out of the classroom. He diverted $1 billion away from public schools to fund his voucher scam. Under Abbott's watch, thousands of great, experienced teachers have left the classroom and are being replaced by uncertified first-time teachers.
It's time we get back to the basics where we put our best teachers in the classroom and support them however we can. That means smaller class sizes, less high-stakes standardized testing for our students, and yes, increasing teacher pay.
And for me, this isn't lip service. This is a fight I've been committed to as a state legislator. I helped negotiate the historic 2019 school finance bill that put more money into Texas classrooms -- $11 billion worth. I fought to reduce the number of STAAR tests our kids take. And I fought Abbott's voucher scam FOUR separate times.
I've sat with parents worried about overcrowded classrooms and teachers buying supplies out of their own pockets. Those conversations illustrate who is impacted when leaders fail to invest in education.
My race for school board taught me something special that I've never forgotten: **Never underestimate what ordinary people can do when they decide to fight for something that matters.**
And the quality of kids' education absolutely matters.
This is the fight I'm carrying with me in my race for Governor. We have to ask ourselves:_Is this the Texas that is by and for the people or is this great state the billionaire 's world and the rest of us just live here?_ That is what we have to think about when we cast our votes on Election Day.
We have about 12 weeks until our election. That's 12 weeks left to show up across Texas, listen to people in every corner of the state, and build the kind of campaign that earns trust and delivers real change.
Recent polling has shown that I'm statistically tied with Greg Abbott. That's proof that not only is change possible, it's what's on the ballot this November.
**[If you 're in this fight with me and believe our kids and our teachers deserve more, will you chip in $5 or whatever makes sense for you today? I'm running to be your next Governor of Texas, and it would mean the world to have you by my side.](https://substack.com/redirect/696ccb56-b5b2-4099-b56a-9c52787717bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you for reading,
Gina

JONESBOROUGH, Tenn. - Fresh off a primary victory driven by the second-highest Democratic voter turnout in the history of the district by raw numbers, U.S. House nominee Kristi Burke is stepping straight back into conversation with voters.
On Saturday, August 15, Burke will join state house candidates Brad Batt and Sarah Jayne Della Vecchia for a joint town hall at the Jonesborough Visitors Center. With the general election on November 3 just under three months away, the event gives voters their first opportunity to hear directly from Burke and ask questions since she secured the Democratic nomination last week.
Burke, who is running to represent Tennessee's 1st Congressional District by defeating Republican incumbent Diana Harshbarger in November, sees the gathering as a natural continuation of the momentum built during the primary.
"When people show up in these numbers, they are sending a clear message that they want real representation," Burke said. "We built this momentum by talking honestly about what working families are going through in Northeast Tennessee. Turning toward November means keeping that door wide open. Representation starts with listening, answering questions, and standing side by side with the community."
The event is jointly hosted by all three candidates, bringing together local and federal voices on one stage. Joining Burke are Brad Batt, running for Tennessee House District 6 against incumbent Tim Hicks, and Sarah Jayne Della Vecchia, running for Tennessee House District 7 against incumbent Rebecca Alexander.
The town hall is free and open to everyone.
**Event Details**
* Saturday, August 15
* Doors open at 3:00 PM (browse information tables and connect with neighbors)
* Program starts at 3:30 PM (candidate remarks followed by live audience Q&A)
* Jonesborough Visitors Center (117 Boone Street, Jonesborough, TN)
* Free admission

Following remarks from each candidate, the microphone belongs to the audience for a live Q&A session. Attendees are invited to stay after the discussion to chat one-on-one with the candidates and learn how to get involved.

# MEDIA ADVISORY

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 14, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com
**PRESS ADVISORY: LILY TANG WILLIAMS CONTINUES “ASK ME ANYTHING” TOWN HALL SERIES WITH STOPS IN WEARE AND WEST LEBANON**

WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams will continue her _Ask Me Anything _Town Hall Series with two upcoming events in Weare and West Lebanon, giving Granite Staters direct, unscripted access to the candidate and an opportunity to ask questions about the issues that matter most to them.

The town hall series is built around a simple premise: Your questions. Her answers. No pre-screened questions and no topics off limits.

The upcoming events are open to the public and members of the media.

**WEARE ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL**

WHEN: Saturday, August 15, 2026
TIME: 10:00–11:00 AM
WHERE: Weare Middle School Library
ADDRESS: 16 E Weare Rd, Weare, NH **WEST LEBANON ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL**

WHEN: Wednesday, August 19, 2026
TIME: 7:00–8:30 PM
WHERE: Kilton Library
ADDRESS: 80 Main St., West Lebanon, NH “Granite Staters deserve representatives who are willing to show up, listen, and answer their questions directly,” said Williams. “That is exactly what these town halls are about. Bring your questions. I’m ready to answer them.” _**Members of the media are encouraged to attend and cover both events.**_

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

It's **_YOU. _** Rather than throw a series of numbers at you, here's the conclusion (with the numbers at the end of this email for those who are interested): **We have 1,037 volunteers currently signed up for our campaign. name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: All Around America: Denali is Undeniable
body:
Celebrate America’s incredible wilderness this summer
Celebrate America’s incredible wilderness this summer
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/5888616/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
###
North America is home to some of the most incredible landscapes on Earth – and this summer, Defenders is taking you there! Join us as we celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States by bringing you to our most incredible wildlife refuges, national forests and more, including some in your own neck of the woods!
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/5888617/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Let’s go to Denali National Park & Preserve!_**
Denali: “the Great One” in its native Athabascan language. Wide open, tranquil, colorful, breathtaking – these are just a few of the words that describe Denali National Park & Preserve! At over 6 million acres, Denali is the third largest national park in the United States. Tourists come from all over the world to visit the park and explore all it has to offer: hiking, camping, wildlife photography, and especially a chance to see Denali itself, the highest mountain peak in all of North America.
#
A single road crosses the park, which is almost exclusively traversed by shuttle buses. Visitors can make their way to one of a number of viewpoints throughout the park with incredible views of Denali’s rivers, tundra, wildflowers, mountain peaks and snowy expanses, while backpackers and mountaineers hike and climb deep into the wilderness for an incredible opportunity to connect with nature in a place like no other.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Meet Alaska’s wildlife_**
The wild denizens of Denali include iconic Alaskan wildlife like moose, caribou, wolves, bears, birds and many more species. Much of this ecosystem is intact, allowing these animals to live and thrive in Denali as they have since time immemorial. Tourists journey to Denali for the chance to catch a glimpse of wildlife in nature in this “living laboratory.” It’s important to stay safe when entering these animals’ home, so the National Parks Service provides information on [**how to stay safe around wildlife.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5888618/38SyG9Xl)
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_What can I do there?_**
Because of its popularity, Denali provides many ways to enjoy this landscape. You may want to tour the Visitor Center, where you can learn about the region’s native people and the history of the park’s name. From there you can travel to viewing points along Denali’s only road by shuttle, where you may be lucky enough to see caribou, migratory birds, brown bears, and other wildlife as well as Denali, the park’s mightiest peak and namesake. If you want to see all that Denali has to offer, you can extend your stay by camping in a tent or RV at designated campgrounds, or you can get a backcountry camping permit – either of which will give you an opportunity to see incredible Alaskan sunsets.
#
Don’t take our word for it - NPS also provides [**guidance on how to make the most of your time in Denali**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5888619/38SyG9Xl) based on the length of your stay. Make a plan and enjoy all that Denali and its natural splendor has to offer!
#
|
---
| | |
---
#

| | Neither Donald Trump nor Health Secretary RFK Jr. has medical or scientific training. _That has not stopped either of them from undermining scientific recommendations and the teams that have kept us safe by gutting the public health agencies and medical research funding Americans rely on._ **This week, Trump has signed an executive order to overhaul the federal childhood vaccine schedule, disregarding decades of evidence about how to safely and effectively protect our kids from preventable diseases.** We learned during the COVID-19 pandemic just how dangerous it is when politics and conspiracy theories get in the way of public health. And now, measles cases are surging again. So far this year, the U.S. has recorded more than 2,400 measles cases, the highest annual total since measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000. Trump’s policies are already making our communities poorer and hungrier. At the same time, he and RFK Jr. are pushing debunked claims and putting decades of public health progress at risk. [**We need more clinicians and public health experts in office who will stand up to conspiracy theories with evidence. | | 91 years ago today, FDR signed the Social Security Act. This codified a promise: **that if you work hard, you will be able to retire with dignity — and your government will be there for you.** It is our duty to continue to uphold that promise. But Republicans see otherwise. They think Social Security is an "entitlement," not something people _earn._ I was there when Republicans attempted to privatize Social Security more than 20 years ago. We stood strong and stopped them. But they never gave up. Last year, when Republicans passed Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill," they plundered $168 billion from Social Security funds, speeding up the date at which this program runs out of money to 2032. We have just a few years to act before Social Security runs out of money and Americans are no longer able to rely on the guarantee of retiring with dignity. As a county judge, Tano locked away hardened criminals and will continue to fight to support law enforcement and the American Dream. Eric Flores (TX-34): A US Army Veteran, Eric will be a champion for our veterans, fight to keep the border secure, and put a stop to migrant crime in our communities. Greg Cunningham (NM-02): A Marine Veteran and law enforcement officer, Greg will fight for law enforcement, bring down the costs of energy, and keep the Southern border secure. John Braun (WA-03): A retired Navy Captain and job-creating manufacturer, John will fight to create more American jobs. Eric Conroy (OH-01): An Air Force Captain Veteran who answered the call when the Twin Towers fell on 9/11, Eric will fight for working families and revitalize Main Street America. Jim Desmond (CA-48): A Navy Veteran and commercial pilot, Jim will fight to lower costs and deliver safer communities. With summer winding down and election season ramping up, our Small Town PAC candidates need all the support they can get heading into these critical midterms.
That’s why **we’ve set a goal to raise $25,000 ahead of our mid-month fundraising deadline on Sunday** — but we need your help to get there.

But to keep their campaigns strong and help them flip their districts from red to blue, we need to make sure they have the resources needed to win. **MAGA megadonors and super PACs are already pouring endless money into this general election, and we know exactly why.**

Tim

clean_body: Peter, Hard work built this country, and nothing good ever comes easy. I know all about what it means to work hard to achieve your dreams, and I am no stranger to a challenge. But I owe you the truth. Right now, we are facing a harsh reality: Make no mistake: the out-of-control Democrats aren't just coming for our laws; they are coming for our way of life. The only thing they hate more than America itself is the fearless MAGA patriots who refuse to bow, refuse to yield, and refuse to let our Senate majority just slip away. They might have Washington elites and radical donors funding their agenda, but I know we have something far more powerful: We have hardworking, freedom-loving patriots across this country who refuse to watch our conservative values be washed away. Time is running out, Peter. Midterms are right around the corner. If we want to defend our conservative values, secure our borders, protect our freedoms, and keep America strong, we must hold the line. Peter, I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Tyler was a commercial pilot for 14 years... until Joe Biden 's TSA revoked his commercial pilot's license for "suspicion of terrorism" without even being charged with a crime. As a result of his lost pilot's salary, Tyler's family business is now in bankruptcy, and he, his wife, and their four kids are in desperate need of your support. I promised Tyler Stand in the Gap could help raise the funds he needs to get his company back on track, and Peter, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment: My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends. After President Trump's speech, I went to the Capitol. What I saw with my own eyes did not match what the news reported. On March 26, 2021, the TSA revoked my commercial pilot 's license for "suspicion of terrorism" and being a threat to the national airspace -- before I was ever charged with a crime and before any FBI interview.I spent $40,000 in legal fees. In June 2021, Allegiant fired me. Without my W-2 income, I could no longer sustain the construction company my wife and I owned. It is now in bankruptcy. We have four children. I now work 6-7 days a week in construction just to survive. I'm hoping Stand in the Gap can help us raise $25,000 to stabilize our family and our company during this bankruptcy and help us recover from the financial destruction caused by the sudden end of my aviation career. We have nowhere else to turn. Thank you for anything you can do. -- Tyler Tew Tyler's story is why we started our Fund Their Futures fundraising program, Peter. President Trump's pardons gave these patriots back their freedom... but that did NOT give them their lives, careers, businesses, or homes back. Tyler did everything right for decades... building a wonderful career, a small business, and a loving family. It all ended WITHOUT due process ... simply because the Far-Left wanted to punish him for supporting President Trump. Your gift today will give Tyler and his family breathing room. It'll help stabilize their company and help them keep a roof over their heads. Stand with the Gap exists specifically for moments like this... to when the legal fight is over, but the fight to survive has just begun. Too often, Stand in the Gap is the for the men and women who faced political persecution and financial ruin after January 6. We exist to share the burden and make it lighter ... and your generosity is quite literally the difference between families like Tyler's losing everything. That's why I hope you'll step forward, Peter. Even just a few dollars could make a critical difference. Thank you so much for helping them out. **It's the largest Democratic field operation ever assembled this early in Georgia.**
**_That didn't happen by accident._**

**_You built this._**

Anchor Point • Wealth Preservation Briefing

When most people think about leaving something behind for their kids or grandkids, they default to **cash, stocks, or real estate.**

The problem?

Every one of those inheritances **leaves a paper trail.** Bank accounts are reported. Brokerage statements are tracked. Real estate transfers require government paperwork.

**The IRS loves it. Easy to track, easy to tax.**

But there's one inheritance asset that works differently: **physical gold.**

Unlike stocks or cash in the bank, **gold coins don't generate automatic IRS forms.**

When you buy popular coins like American Gold Eagles and store them at home or in a private vault, they sit outside the banking system.

That's why many families are turning to gold. It's private, durable, and completely under your control.

What most people don't realize is that you don't need a separate stash of cash to do it.

You can use the retirement savings you already have — in a **401(k), IRA, or TSP** — to buy real gold coins and bars.

And if you're 591⁄2 or older, **this purchase is completely tax-deferred and penalty-free.**

Once you retire, you even have the option to take delivery of those metals right to your home.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Hey folks,
I'm fired up about this one.
John Fetterman says he won't campaign against Republican Senator Dave McCormick--and I think Democrats need to start acting like Fetterman has already left the party.
But this goes way beyond one senator. We need to talk about who actually fights for our values, who profits from tearing Democrats down, and why independent voices matter more than ever.
* [**00:01:04**] Fetterman calls Republican Dave McCormick his "friend" and makes an extraordinary promise about 2030.
* [**00:03:13**] Why a razor-thin Democratic Senate majority could make Fetterman an enormous liability when the stakes are highest.
* [**00:05:38**] The progressive Fetterman campaigned as versus the politician we're watching today.
* [**00:08:43**] I unload on the cottage industry of Democrats going on Fox News to attack other Democrats.
* [**00:10:32**] What being truly independent means--and why you deserve to know who's actually behind the voices shaping our politics.

This episode is about Fetterman, but it's also about something much bigger: power, money, loyalty, and whether the people talking to you about politics actually believe what they're saying. Politics isn't a game. People's lives are affected by these choices every single day, and we need leaders--and media--willing to fight like it matters. **Friday, August 14, 2026 -**_** ** Two ships attacked in Strait of Hormuz, UAE blames Iran. U.S. sends new carrier to Middle East. Traffic through Hormuz seems to grind to a halt. U.S. threatens economic punishment for Iran that has "never been seen" as War Secretary Pete Hegseth vows indefinite blockade. U.S. has lost 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones, roughly 25% of fleet, in Iran war. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz orders transfer of West Bank enforcement powers; Palestinian commission says move advances annexation. Israel blockade on oil and spare parts from entering Gaza endangers thousands, MSF says. Gaza cancer patients dying at 2-3 times prewar rate, Reuters reports. Jared Kushner to visit Israel next week. Israel continues military activity in Lebanon despite "ceasefire." Israel demolished a 60-apartment complex in Lebanon, official says. Human Rights Watch urges UN to keep international force in southern Lebanon beyond 2026. Flock Safety announces mandatory audit changes amid mounting scrutiny over misuse. DHS documents show broad surveillance of left-leaning groups during Minnesota immigration crackdown. Border czar Tom Homan defends ICE plan to equip officers with electric shock gloves. Trump signs proclamations imposing drone tariffs, allowing limited foreign warship construction. Vice President JD Vance asks Department of Justice to investigate hospitals over transgender care. DOJ finds California prisons systematically fail to protect women from guard sexual abuse. Federal judge dismisses Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard. Progressive Florida slate rally moves to church after venue tried to bar Rep. Rashida Tlaib. CIA behind Ecuadorian fishing attacks, WaPo reports. Russia rejects Black Sea ceasefire proposal. UN warns that 650,000 refugees in South Sudan could lose food aid. Chadian president pardons jailed opposition leaders. Hundreds across Canada target Elbit suppliers in "people's arms embargo."_

* * *
# Iran
* **Two ships attacked in Hormuz, UAE blames Iran:** The UAE [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/1f6322d9-94b6-437c-a6d1-c835d5eafbfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Iran of attacking two vessels affiliated with the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company on Thursday, while the ships were transiting the Strait of Hormuz. No injuries were reported as a result of the attack.
* The UAE Foreign Ministry called the attack a violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2817 and an "act of piracy" by Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps. It demanded that Iran halt its attacks and "completely and unconditionally" reopen the Strait
* **U.S. sends new carrier to Middle East:** The U.S. aircraft carrier USS George Washington [headed](https://substack.com/redirect/b4056d98-da61-4936-80d1-91b3d3c7b69e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Middle East on Thursday to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed in the region for more than 250 days, according to an announcement from the Navy.
* The George Washington strike group departed Vietnam on August 12, the Navy said.
* The Lincoln's deployment had been expected to end in May but was extended as the U.S. war on Iran continued.
* The news comes after reports this week that multiple sailors had attempted to jump overboard from the USS Abraham Lincoln amid grueling deployment conditions for the ship's 5,000-person crew.
* **Traffic through Hormuz seems to grind to a halt:** West-to-east tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed after a brief burst of outbound flows, according to data published by Kpler on Thursday.
* From August 7 through 13, 19 tankers carried 16.7 million barrels out of the Gulf. Nearly all of that moved during the first four days with 16 tankers carrying 16.3 million barrels.
* From August 11 through 13, just three Iran-linked tankers crossed, carrying only 0.4 million barrels combined.
* **U.S. threatens economic punishment for Iran that has "never been seen" as Hegseth vows indefinite blockade:** U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [threatened](https://substack.com/redirect/21c9ab15-f1e3-4232-9661-e5ecd090c5f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to impose measures on Iran that have "never been seen in the history of economic isolation on a country," during a Thursday interview on Newsmax.
* Bessent described the plan as a "combination of economic isolation" and "the continued blockade in the Strait of Hormuz" of Iranian ports.
* Separately, U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth said the U.S. can [maintain](https://substack.com/redirect/b6203255-6174-47f7-9461-6e3e5679e5fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its naval blockade of Iranian ports "indefinitely" on Thursday, as the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz drags on.
* Hegseth told reporters in Panama that the U.S. could "rotate ships in and out" to keep up the embargo. "We'll hold it as long as we need to," he said.

* **U.S. has lost 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones, roughly 25% of fleet, in Iran war** : The U.S. military has [lost](https://substack.com/redirect/c41f6e30-1f87-44fd-b232-8b00207c4d27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones during its war with Iran, representing about a quarter of the pre-war fleet and a potential taxpayer cost exceeding $1.3 billion, according to three officials cited by The Washington Post on Friday.
* The losses add to a broader depletion of U.S. munitions, including more than 850 Tomahawk cruise missiles and over 1,000 Patriot and THAAD missiles fired in the campaign's first month.
* The Trump administration is seeking a $67 billion supplemental budget from the U.S. Senate to restock the arsenal.
* Iranian forces intercepted and destroyed an MQ9-Reaper drone over Hormozgan province on Friday, according to Iranian state TV.
* **Drones intercepted over Iraqi Kurdistan:** Iraqi air defense systems [intercepted](https://substack.com/redirect/a98a2705-a7ce-4d6e-985f-2296a9bab3e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) drones over the northern Kurdish province of Erbil early Thursday, Iraqi security sources told Al Jazeera.
* Local media footage showed the remnants of the drones falling onto a residential area near Erbil International Airport. No casualties were reported.
* It was not immediately clear where the drones were launched from or what their intended target was. Erbil, the capital of Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdistan region, hosts U.S. forces and has been struck repeatedly by Iran.
* **Iraqi state oil company says UAE firm is buying its crude:** Iraq's state oil marketing company SOMO [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/6dbd64ef-5da9-43c6-ad50-231f39146acb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Wednesday that Abu Dhabi's ADNOC is among the firms buying its crude and now helping transport Iraqi crude through the Strait of Hormuz, following a Bloomberg report that ADNOC's trading arm offered Iraq to use its "dark-transit" shuttle system.
* Under the arrangement, tankers make short crossings with their tracking systems switched off, then transfer the crude to other vessels outside the Persian Gulf. The strategy has helped maintain exports through the blockaded Strait.

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah says it struck Saudi Aramco facility:** Yemen's Ansarallah movement [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/ea3c2413-3e89-44d5-b457-2e892166277f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) operations against Saudi Arabia and around the Bab Al-Mandab on Thursday as fighting continued in the city of Taiz in southwestern Yemen, with a military source telling the Yemeni outlet Saba that two drones struck an Aramco facility in Jizan. This follows two previous attacks claimed by Ansarallah on the same facility in late July and August.
* The source said the operation answered Saudi violations of Yemeni airspace and sovereignty in Saada and Hajjah and warned of further retaliation.
* Saba separately reported that Ansarallah targeted the Bab Al-Mandab area with two missiles. Details were not immediately available.
* In Taiz, a shell fired by Saudi-backed forces struck the wholesale fish market in Salah district, causing extensive property damage. No casualties were reported.
* **Iran rejects U.S. claims that flights to Yemen carry military personnel or equipment:** Iran [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/fcfff4cc-14c0-45c3-bb0b-ffacd3595b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. allegations that Iranian commercial flights to Sana'a are transporting military personnel or equipment in violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2216, calling the claims "completely baseless" and unsupported by evidence, Iran's Mehr News Agency reported.
* In a letter to UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and the Security Council president, the Iranian envoy claimed recent Iranian flights to Yemen were "humanitarian in nature" and accused Washington of trying to "distort the facts" and divert attention from its own military actions and support for the blockade of Yemen.

# Palestine
* **Israel attacks fishermen off Gaza coast:** Israeli naval boats [opened fire](https://substack.com/redirect/00fe7f95-793e-4847-980b-6129c984cb58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on a fishing boat west of Gaza City on Friday, according to WAFA, injuring three fishermen.
* **Israel continues its assault on the occupied West Bank:**
* **Nablus:** Israeli forces [blocked](https://substack.com/redirect/f54be1ea-5749-4cc8-8d96-557fb43873dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israeli and foreign aid groups trying to access three homes in Nablus town of Qusra. The homes have been under siege by settlers for nearly a week, according to WAFA, who are also preventing families from accessing basic necessities during the assault. (Israeli anti-occupation Knesset member Ofer Cassif [said](https://substack.com/redirect/c75b5800-dd99-462a-8b05-bdbc60db14e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he used his parliamentary immunity to cross an Israeli police blockade and deliver some water, food and medicine to the families. Cassif also said he brought equipment to restore their water supply, which had been cut by "settler terrorists.") Separately, in the city of Nablus, Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/e5f83cec-bc6f-4c54-8626-586fe5538f01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) four Palestinians during a Friday morning raid, ransacking several homes. Israeli forces also expelled Palestinian families at gunpoint on Thursday and seized three newly built, multi-story homes in Jalud, south of Nablus, converting them into military posts and watchtowers, Haaretz [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/67e844cf-dae2-46b9-80c6-33032ad89e4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/9a2bddb0-fad7-4b79-9917-f9444aeca00f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 14-year-old in the village of Al-Kum, WAFA reported on Friday. On Thursday evening, Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian homes in Al-Buweira with stones and fired live ammunition toward them, and then raided the area, detaining dozens in the process.
* **Jenin:** Israeli settlers wearing military uniforms [assaulted](https://substack.com/redirect/21841972-1ec0-4752-97b5-d4890f6b443b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian crew from an electrical utility on Friday, briefly detaining two and seizing money from one of them, WAFA reported. Israeli settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/91cc8f5e-796f-4b53-b269-c4a2f9a7d8e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a vehicle between the towns of Arraba and Ya'bad on Thursday evening, using pepper spray and wounding three of the vehicle's passengers, including a child.
* **Ramallah** : Israeli settlers [damaged](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfd9c81-bf7d-4463-bf14-4d99438259ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinian property between the villages of Al-Mughayyir and Abu Falah on Friday, dismantling water tanks. Israeli settlers also [began](https://substack.com/redirect/b69d344e-a7e7-471f-adde-ba0fad3f8f28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to establish a new colonial outpost near the Palestinian towns of Silwad and Deir Jarir on Friday, setting up a tent on land owned by the former town.
* **Katz orders transfer of West Bank enforcement powers; Palestinian commission says move advances annexation:** Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/0348255d-1908-4457-9e1f-319c498a67df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the military to prepare a plan to transfer enforcement powers over Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank to the Israel Police, saying the military should not "chase youth in the hilltops" and citing an "expected welcome increase in the number of settlers" following the government's approval of new settlements.
* The directive, which has not yet taken effect, [represents](https://substack.com/redirect/635afdaa-0c18-46d5-a7e3-c6915053b7f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an advanced step in Israel's "administrative and legal annexation" of the occupied West Bank by further shifting authority from the military administration to Israeli civilian institutions, treating settlers increasingly as though they were inside Israel while Palestinians remain subject to military rule, the Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said.
* Palestinian Authority Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh condemned the move, saying it "represents a new attempt to impose Israeli law and sovereignty over the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and to entrench the unlawful annexation of Palestinian territory."
* **Israel blockade on oil and spare parts from entering Gaza endangers thousands, MSF says:** Israel is [placing](https://substack.com/redirect/44906179-62a6-4609-ab68-298e59487cb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) thousands of Palestinians in Gaza at heightened risk of death and severe illness as hospital generators, ambulances, water pumps, and water trucks begin to fail, the medical charity Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said.
* MSF noted the rising costs of engine oil, which can exceed $1,300 per liter, 20 times its price six months ago.
* It also highlighted the risks electricity rationing posed to hospital operations and water access. A damaged generator, for example, forced MSF to cut daily water production from 600,000 to 350,000 liters, depriving more than 40,000 people of water each day.
* "This is not bureaucracy," said the group's Filipe Ribeiro. "It is a deliberate effort to make existence itself impossible."

* **Gaza cancer patients dying at 2-3 times prewar rate, Reuters reports:** Gaza cancer patients are [dying](https://substack.com/redirect/fe6343ef-178a-4908-b8de-d44a16486b51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at two to three times the prewar rate after Israel destroyed the enclave's only specialized cancer hospital and blocked thousands from leaving for treatment, Reuters reported on Thursday.
* An estimated 17,000 cancer patients now have no access to chemotherapy or advanced care inside Gaza. Another 20,000 patients are registered for treatment abroad, including 5,000 with cancer, but have not been permitted to leave.
* Doctors report three to five cancer deaths daily, up from one to two before the war. Gaza's remaining hospitals lack up to 70% of essential medical supplies, while specialists warn toxic materials from Israeli explosives may be accelerating cancer rates.
* "Every day my disease progresses," said a 33-year-old woman with cancer. "I am just waiting to die."

* **Kushner to visit Israel next week:** Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law and Board of Peace member, [plans](https://substack.com/redirect/398a2161-13e3-451c-91f7-68a5d1c493ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to visit Israel next week for talks on Gaza, Axios reported.
* The visit is reportedly set to focus on advancing the Board of Peace's plan. Netanyahu said Israel "rejects" Trump's 15-point roadmap, which would include Hamas disarmament and a phased Israeli withdrawal.
* A U.S. official told Axios the two sides "see eye-to-eye on the strategic goal, but Israel has expressed some doubts about the plan."

# Lebanon
* **Israel continues military activity in Lebanon despite "ceasefire": ** Israeli forces carried out a series of attacks across southern Lebanon on Thursday and Friday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/85f16d17-1775-42f0-a20e-3a7fbad26513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two explosions in Bint Jbeil and Kounine in Bint Jbeil district and a large explosion in Markaba in Marjayoun district. Forces also bulldozed homes in Bani Hayyan in Marjayoun district, where fires broke out amid continued shelling.
* Israeli warplanes and drones meanwhile repeatedly [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/348f3fe6-befc-4392-8420-9e287ea29211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the outskirts of Mansouri and Majdal Zoun in Tyre (Sour) district, alongside demolition operations in the al-Mashaa neighborhood east of Mansouri.
* On Thursday, the Israeli army [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/24ca5e07-83cf-4c8f-a1c1-08233b9a177c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) detonations and demolitions in Taybeh, Aita Al-Jabal, and Bani Hayyan, according to L'orient Today. Israeli Merkava tanks were also seen moving near the eastern outskirts of Kfar Shuba.
* **Israel demolished a 60-apartment complex in Lebanon, official says:** Ten days ago, Israeli forces [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/a3170f64-6f79-4371-9bdc-d8b1757f9999?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a residential complex of around 60 apartments in Kfar Tibnit, in Lebanon's Nabatieh region, the town's mukhtar told L'Orient Today.
* The mukhtar said "one of the major demolitions" targeted the Ward complex, made up of 14 buildings. "The complex was completely destroyed," he said. Several other homes were similarly targeted.
* **HRW urges UN to keep international force in southern Lebanon beyond 2026:** Human Rights Watch [called on](https://substack.com/redirect/8ff4d4d9-03f4-4d32-99d7-8994574cf5c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the UN Security Council Thursday to delay UNIFIL's planned withdrawal from southern Lebanon and ensure a robust international force remains to protect civilians. The Security Council voted in August 2025 to extend UNIFIL's mandate for a final time through 2026, before the latest war erupted in March and Israeli forces displaced hundreds of thousands of people and occupied large areas of southern Lebanon.
* HRW said the security situation has since "dramatically worsened," with Israeli attacks killing more than 4,333 people and wounding over 12,250 since March 2, according to Lebanon's Health Ministry.
* "Pulling the plug on UNIFIL without a robust international force in place would effectively abandon millions of Lebanese civilians to an uncertain and potentially disastrous fate," HRW's UN director said.

# U.S. News
* **Flock Safety announces mandatory audit changes amid mounting scrutiny over misuse:** Flock Safety, whose network of automated license plate cameras is used by law enforcement agencies in 49 states, [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/f494694b-e2d3-49b1-a1db-d6c37c5368d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday it will require customers to implement an audit tool flagging abnormal searches, shorten its data retention from 30 to seven days, and mandate that officers enter a case number before running searches.
* A Washington Post investigation earlier this month found nearly 50 instances of officers charged or accused of misusing the cameras, often to track romantic partners or family members.
* Six employees of the Savannah, Georgia police department were fired earlier this week for searching for friends and family using Flock technology.
* More than 50 agencies nationwide have canceled or suspended Flock contracts since the start of the year, according to tracking group DeFlock.
* **DHS documents show broad surveillance of left-leaning groups during Minnesota immigration crackdown:** The Department of Homeland Security [opened](https://substack.com/redirect/f54564a2-ac60-4195-ab3e-57d9c77cac6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an investigation into labor unions, climate groups, and progressive organizations during the Trump administration's immigration crackdown in Minnesota earlier this year. Homeland Security launched the investigation days after Border Patrol agents fatally shot nurse **Alex Pretti** in January, using administrative subpoenas to obtain years of financial records from the groups, according to the New York Times.
* Homeland Security obtained financial records of a number of non profits and prominent unions, including the Sunrise Movement, the Communications Workers of America, and the Service Employees International Union.
* Documents reviewed by the Times also detail an undercover surveillance operation in which agents infiltrated Signal group chats and took names and license plate numbers of people at meetings in churches, libraries, and parks.
* Prosecutors ultimately indicted 15 people connected to the "antifa" in June after presenting grand jurors with a slide claiming 18 groups, including the AFL-CIO, were part of a conspiracy to obstruct immigration agents.
* **Homan defends ICE plan to equip officers with electric shock gloves** : White House border czar **Tom Homan** [defended](https://substack.com/redirect/f2ac53bb-dacf-4c97-ab90-17392f4744a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Immigration and Customs Enforcement's plan to spend up to $20 million on electric shock gloves for officers, telling Fox News a de-escalation tool that could help avoid deadly force.
* The gloves, known as G.L.O.V.E. and manufactured by Compliant Technologies LLC, have drawn criticism from civil rights groups and Democrats amid concerns that ICE agents have been too quick to use force, with at least six people shot and killed by immigration agents since last year, including motorists in Maine and Texas last month.
* Homan said deployment of the devices would take "awhile" as the agency works out training protocols.
* **Trump signs proclamations imposing drone tariffs, allowing limited foreign warship construction** : President Donald Trump [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/6d51aeb2-9299-4374-9350-0e2843bf9899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two proclamations Thursday, one imposing tariffs on drones and drone parts and another directing the Navy to allow limited foreign shipbuilding.
* The drone memorandum sets a 100% tariff on "particularly sensitive" drones and 25% on smaller, less security-sensitive models, alongside a 15% tariff on drones from the European Union, Japan, and several other countries, taking effect 21 days after signing, with tariffs on less sensitive components phased in after 180 days.
* The Navy directive orders War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** to replace the Advanced Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch Systems with traditional steam and hydraulic systems, establish a fifth naval shipyard, and temporarily permit foreign shipbuilders to construct up to two American warships in their own shipyards as part of efforts to accelerate production.
* **Vance asks DOJ to investigate hospitals over transgender care:** Vice President **JD Vance** [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/191645f5-61fa-467d-94c2-f31a0fa66700?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Justice Department a government report accusing hospitals of using misleading billing codes for transgender health procedures to secure insurance reimbursement, asking Attorney General **Todd Blanche** to investigate dozens of hospitals nationwide, according to Politico.
* The report from the Department of Health and Human Services, titled "Wolves in White Coats," found that providers billed nearly $50 million for puberty-blocking drugs for patients ages 9 to 17 using endocrine disorder diagnosis codes rather than gender-related ones. The report was released two days after the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services cut off Medicaid funding for gender-affirming care for minors.
* Major medical groups including the American Medical Association and American Academy of Pediatrics support gender-affirming care and have criticized the administration's actions, with AAP President Susan J. Kressly warning that "allowing the government to determine which patient groups deserve care sets a dangerous precedent."
* **DOJ finds California prisons systematically fail to protect women from guard sexual abuse** : The Justice Department [found](https://substack.com/redirect/10f92efc-7a37-4039-88b4-a2fc8c8512ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that California's prison system has systematically failed to protect incarcerated women from sexual abuse and harassment by guards, with staff tasked with investigating misconduct often themselves accused of abuse.
* **Federal judge dismisses Trump administration 's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard:** **Judge Richard G. Stearns** of the U.S. District Court in Massachusetts [dismissed](https://substack.com/redirect/cc0cb81c-947a-4486-b6d2-033172751d7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard University Thursday, ruling that the antisemitic incidents cited in the March lawsuit were "too isolated and episodic" to show the school violated Title VI of the Civil Rights Act.
* The lawsuit had accused Harvard of turning "a blind eye to antisemitism and discrimination against Jews and Israelis" following pro-Palestinian campus protests after the Gaza war began in 2023.
* **Progressive Florida slate rally moves to church after venue tried to bar Rashida Tlaib:** A Friday "Chomp the Oligarchy" rally for a slate of progressive Florida candidates in the Fort Lauderdale area was [relocated](https://substack.com/redirect/7aaa732c-46b0-4e90-aa9b-b5c798915d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a church after its original venue canceled the original booking unless organizers agreed to bar **Rep. Rashida Tlaib** from speaking, a campaign spokesperson told Drop Site's Ryan Grim**.**
* The rally, organized with the Florida Youth Justice Coalition, Gen-Z for Change, and Miami DSA, features Tlaib and Senate candidate **Angie Nixon** , alongside congressional candidates **Elijah Manley**(FL-20) and **Oliver Larkin** (FL-25) and Colorado Democratic congressional nominee **Melat Kiros**.

# Other International News
* **CIA behind Ecuadorian fishing attacks, WaPo reports:** The CIA was behind the April attacks on three Ecuadorian fishing boats near the Galapagos Islands, first [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/0d201cf2-74f2-4718-b605-e8e1ce692158?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on by Drop Site contributor Camila Lourdes Galarza, according to a new investigation from the Washington Post.
* Last month, Galarza first [reported](https://substack.com/@camilalourdesgalarza/p-207463076) for Drop Site that the Ecuadorian prosecutor assigned to investigate the attacks and 36 survivors' allegations of kidnapping and torture by U.S. personnel, told a colleague she was facing internal pressure and institutional stonewalling that was preventing her from pursuing potential U.S. involvement. She was assassinated on June 14.
* **Russia rejects Black Sea ceasefire proposal:** Russia [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/c14167fd-c37c-42c4-a999-b53a00fe7bd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a proposal for a ceasefire on cargo shipping in the Black Sea amid intensifying attacks in recent weeks that have increased global grain prices.
* Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova called it a "deliberate policy aimed at destabilizing civilian shipping in the Black Sea," as a result of Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in the region and rejected the idea of returning to a previous 2022-2023 ceasefire on ships carrying grain.
* The rejection comes after Turkey had floated proposals to both sides for a halt to military operations at sea. Reuters also reported that Ukraine separately transmitted an offer through a third party to stop attacks on civilian targets.
* **UN warns that 650,000 refugees in South Sudan could lose food aid:** UN agencies [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/62593b19-fe2d-476c-95c2-97a8ea8f96ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that more than 650,000 refugees and asylum seekers in South Sudan could lose access to food assistance within weeks because of a severe funding shortfall, with the World Food Programme (WFP) saying no refugees may be receiving food aid by October unless new money is secured.
* The warning comes as South Sudan faces one of the world's worst hunger crises, with 7.8 million people experiencing acute food insecurity and 2.2 million children acutely malnourished.
* The WFP says it needs $37 million for refugee operations to avoid ceasing aid to 180,000 internally displaced people by October and hundreds of thousands more by this winter.
* **Chadian president pardons jailed opposition leaders:** Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Deby [pardoned](https://substack.com/redirect/e6b69599-e2a9-48f6-bcfa-c78de71ea6e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) former prime minister and main opposition leader Succes Masra, along with eight other opposition figures, ending prison terms that critics had denounced as politically motivated.
* **RSF confirms Kurmuk capture as fighting escalates across Sudan:** The UAE-backed RSF said it seized [Kurmuk](https://substack.com/redirect/f58889c5-9869-471b-969b-e0e4e6971db3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the strategic Blue Nile border town on Thursday, with regional monitors reporting Ethiopian support for the operation. Clashes continued there and in Amburu, North Darfur. In North Kordofan, the army said it repelled an RSF assault involving more than 250 combat vehicles on Jabra al-Sheikh, while two civilians were killed in RSF drone strikes on El Obeid, according to Emergency Lawyers. RSF drone attacks were also reported on Khartoum and Omdurman for a second consecutive day.
* **Hundreds across Canada target Elbit suppliers in "people's arms embargo":** Activists with Arms Embargo Now picketed facilities from British Columbia to Newfoundland on Thursday, targeting more than 40 companies tied to Israeli arms manufacturer Elbit Systems, including Ontario-based TTM Technologies, which has shipped millions of dollars in circuit boards for precision-strike munitions. The campaign has already pushed Montreal-based Apollo Microwaves to end its Elbit contracts and Scotiabank, once Elbit's largest foreign shareholder, to divest its roughly $500 million stake. Report from Christopher Ketchum is [here](https://substack.com/redirect/3300053a-2c4b-48e4-9a70-89d71dc65e94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
