This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday Iran Two ships attacked in Hormuz, UAE blames Iran: The UAE Iran of attacking two vessels affiliated with the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company on Thursday, while the ships were transiting the Strait of Hormuz. No injuries were reported as a result of the attack. The UAE Foreign Ministry called the attack a violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2817 and an "act of piracy" by Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps. It demanded that Iran halt its attacks and "completely and unconditionally" reopen the Strait U.S. sends new carrier to Middle East: The U.S. aircraft carrier USS George Washington to the Middle East on Thursday to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed in the region for more than 250 days, according to an announcement from the Navy. The George Washington strike group departed Vietnam on August 12, the Navy said. The Lincoln's deployment had been expected to end in May but was extended as the U.S. war on Iran continued. The news comes after reports this week that multiple sailors had attempted to jump overboard from the USS Abraham Lincoln amid grueling deployment conditions for the ship's 5,000-person crew. Traffic through Hormuz seems to grind to a halt: West-to-east tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed after a brief burst of outbound flows, according to data published by Kpler on Thursday. From August 7 through 13, 19 tankers carried 16.7 million barrels out of the Gulf. Nearly all of that moved during the first four days with 16 tankers carrying 16.3 million barrels. From August 11 through 13, just three Iran-linked tankers crossed, carrying only 0.4 million barrels combined. U.S. threatens economic punishment for Iran that has "never been seen" as Hegseth vows indefinite blockade: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to impose measures on Iran that have "never been seen in the history of economic isolation on a country," during a Thursday interview on Newsmax. Bessent described the plan as a "combination of economic isolation" and "the continued blockade in the Strait of Hormuz" of Iranian ports. Separately, U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth said the U.S. can its naval blockade of Iranian ports "indefinitely" on Thursday, as the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz drags on. Hegseth told reporters in Panama that the U.S. could "rotate ships in and out" to keep up the embargo. "We'll hold it as long as we need to," he said. U.S. has lost 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones, roughly 25% of fleet, in Iran war : The U.S. military has at least 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones during its war with Iran, representing about a quarter of the pre-war fleet and a potential taxpayer cost exceeding $1.3 billion, according to three officials cited by The Washington Post on Friday. The losses add to a broader depletion of U.S. munitions, including more than 850 Tomahawk cruise missiles and over 1,000 Patriot and THAAD missiles fired in the campaign's first month. The Trump administration is seeking a $67 billion supplemental budget from the U.S. Senate to restock the arsenal. Iranian forces intercepted and destroyed an MQ9-Reaper drone over Hormozgan province on Friday, according to Iranian state TV. Drones intercepted over Iraqi Kurdistan: Iraqi air defense systems drones over the northern Kurdish province of Erbil early Thursday, Iraqi security sources told Al Jazeera. Local media footage showed the remnants of the drones falling onto a residential area near Erbil International Airport. No casualties were reported. It was not immediately clear where the drones were launched from or what their intended target was. Erbil, the capital of Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdistan region, hosts U.S. forces and has been struck repeatedly by Iran. Iraqi state oil company says UAE firm is buying its crude: Iraq's state oil marketing company SOMO Wednesday that Abu Dhabi's ADNOC is among the firms buying its crude and now helping transport Iraqi crude through the Strait of Hormuz, following a Bloomberg report that ADNOC's trading arm offered Iraq to use its "dark-transit" shuttle system. Under the arrangement, tankers make short crossings with their tracking systems switched off, then transfer the crude to other vessels outside the Persian Gulf. The strategy has helped maintain exports through the blockaded Strait. Yemen Ansarallah says it struck Saudi Aramco facility: Yemen's Ansarallah movement operations against Saudi Arabia and around the Bab Al-Mandab on Thursday as fighting continued in the city of Taiz in southwestern Yemen, with a military source telling the Yemeni outlet Saba that two drones struck an Aramco facility in Jizan. This follows two previous attacks claimed by Ansarallah on the same facility in late July and August. The source said the operation answered Saudi violations of Yemeni airspace and sovereignty in Saada and Hajjah and warned of further retaliation. Saba separately reported that Ansarallah targeted the Bab Al-Mandab area with two missiles. Details were not immediately available. In Taiz, a shell fired by Saudi-backed forces struck the wholesale fish market in Salah district, causing extensive property damage. No casualties were reported. Iran rejects U.S. claims that flights to Yemen carry military personnel or equipment: Iran U.S. allegations that Iranian commercial flights to Sana'a are transporting military personnel or equipment in violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2216, calling the claims "completely baseless" and unsupported by evidence, Iran's Mehr News Agency reported. In a letter to UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and the Security Council president, the Iranian envoy claimed recent Iranian flights to Yemen were "humanitarian in nature" and accused Washington of trying to "distort the facts" and divert attention from its own military actions and support for the blockade of Yemen. Palestine Israel attacks fishermen off Gaza coast: Israeli naval boats on a fishing boat west of Gaza City on Friday, according to WAFA, injuring three fishermen. Israel continues its assault on the occupied West Bank: Nablus: Israeli forces Israeli and foreign aid groups trying to access three homes in Nablus town of Qusra. The homes have been under siege by settlers for nearly a week, according to WAFA, who are also preventing families from accessing basic necessities during the assault. (Israeli anti-occupation Knesset member Ofer Cassif he used his parliamentary immunity to cross an Israeli police blockade and deliver some water, food and medicine to the families. Cassif also said he brought equipment to restore their water supply, which had been cut by "settler terrorists.") Separately, in the city of Nablus, Israeli forces four Palestinians during a Friday morning raid, ransacking several homes. Israeli forces also expelled Palestinian families at gunpoint on Thursday and seized three newly built, multi-story homes in Jalud, south of Nablus, converting them into military posts and watchtowers, Haaretz . Hebron: Israeli forces a 14-year-old in the village of Al-Kum, WAFA reported on Friday. On Thursday evening, Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian homes in Al-Buweira with stones and fired live ammunition toward them, and then raided the area, detaining dozens in the process. Jenin: Israeli settlers wearing military uniforms a Palestinian crew from an electrical utility on Friday, briefly detaining two and seizing money from one of them, WAFA reported. Israeli settlers a vehicle between the towns of Arraba and Ya'bad on Thursday evening, using pepper spray and wounding three of the vehicle's passengers, including a child. Ramallah : Israeli settlers Palestinian property between the villages of Al-Mughayyir and Abu Falah on Friday, dismantling water tanks. Israeli settlers also to establish a new colonial outpost near the Palestinian towns of Silwad and Deir Jarir on Friday, setting up a tent on land owned by the former town. Katz orders transfer of West Bank enforcement powers; Palestinian commission says move advances annexation: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz the military to prepare a plan to transfer enforcement powers over Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank to the Israel Police, saying the military should not "chase youth in the hilltops" and citing an "expected welcome increase in the number of settlers" following the government's approval of new settlements. The directive, which has not yet taken effect, an advanced step in Israel's "administrative and legal annexation" of the occupied West Bank by further shifting authority from the military administration to Israeli civilian institutions, treating settlers increasingly as though they were inside Israel while Palestinians remain subject to military rule, the Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said. Palestinian Authority Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh condemned the move, saying it "represents a new attempt to impose Israeli law and sovereignty over the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and to entrench the unlawful annexation of Palestinian territory." Israel blockade on oil and spare parts from entering Gaza endangers thousands, MSF says: Israel is thousands of Palestinians in Gaza at heightened risk of death and severe illness as hospital generators, ambulances, water pumps, and water trucks begin to fail, the medical charity Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said. MSF noted the rising costs of engine oil, which can exceed $1,300 per liter, 20 times its price six months ago. It also highlighted the risks electricity rationing posed to hospital operations and water access. A damaged generator, for example, forced MSF to cut daily water production from 600,000 to 350,000 liters, depriving more than 40,000 people of water each day. "This is not bureaucracy," said the group's Filipe Ribeiro. "It is a deliberate effort to make existence itself impossible." Gaza cancer patients dying at 2-3 times prewar rate, Reuters reports: Gaza cancer patients are at two to three times the prewar rate after Israel destroyed the enclave's only specialized cancer hospital and blocked thousands from leaving for treatment, Reuters reported on Thursday. An estimated 17,000 cancer patients now have no access to chemotherapy or advanced care inside Gaza. Another 20,000 patients are registered for treatment abroad, including 5,000 with cancer, but have not been permitted to leave. Doctors report three to five cancer deaths daily, up from one to two before the war. Gaza's remaining hospitals lack up to 70% of essential medical supplies, while specialists warn toxic materials from Israeli explosives may be accelerating cancer rates. "Every day my disease progresses," said a 33-year-old woman with cancer. "I am just waiting to die." Kushner to visit Israel next week: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law and Board of Peace member, to visit Israel next week for talks on Gaza, Axios reported. The visit is reportedly set to focus on advancing the Board of Peace's plan. Netanyahu said Israel "rejects" Trump's 15-point roadmap, which would include Hamas disarmament and a phased Israeli withdrawal. A U.S. official told Axios the two sides "see eye-to-eye on the strategic goal, but Israel has expressed some doubts about the plan." Lebanon Israel continues military activity in Lebanon despite "ceasefire": Israeli forces carried out a series of attacks across southern Lebanon on Thursday and Friday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. Israeli forces two explosions in Bint Jbeil and Kounine in Bint Jbeil district and a large explosion in Markaba in Marjayoun district. Forces also bulldozed homes in Bani Hayyan in Marjayoun district, where fires broke out amid continued shelling. Israeli warplanes and drones meanwhile repeatedly the outskirts of Mansouri and Majdal Zoun in Tyre (Sour) district, alongside demolition operations in the al-Mashaa neighborhood east of Mansouri. On Thursday, the Israeli army detonations and demolitions in Taybeh, Aita Al-Jabal, and Bani Hayyan, according to L'orient Today. Israeli Merkava tanks were also seen moving near the eastern outskirts of Kfar Shuba. Israel demolished a 60-apartment complex in Lebanon, official says: Ten days ago, Israeli forces a residential complex of around 60 apartments in Kfar Tibnit, in Lebanon's Nabatieh region, the town's mukhtar told L'Orient Today. The mukhtar said "one of the major demolitions" targeted the Ward complex, made up of 14 buildings. "The complex was completely destroyed," he said. Several other homes were similarly targeted. HRW urges UN to keep international force in southern Lebanon beyond 2026: Human Rights Watch the UN Security Council Thursday to delay UNIFIL's planned withdrawal from southern Lebanon and ensure a robust international force remains to protect civilians. The Security Council voted in August 2025 to extend UNIFIL's mandate for a final time through 2026, before the latest war erupted in March and Israeli forces displaced hundreds of thousands of people and occupied large areas of southern Lebanon. HRW said the security situation has since "dramatically worsened," with Israeli attacks killing more than 4,333 people and wounding over 12,250 since March 2, according to Lebanon's Health Ministry. "Pulling the plug on UNIFIL without a robust international force in place would effectively abandon millions of Lebanese civilians to an uncertain and potentially disastrous fate," HRW's UN director said. U.S. News Flock Safety announces mandatory audit changes amid mounting scrutiny over misuse: Flock Safety, whose network of automated license plate cameras is used by law enforcement agencies in 49 states, Thursday it will require customers to implement an audit tool flagging abnormal searches, shorten its data retention from 30 to seven days, and mandate that officers enter a case number before running searches. A Washington Post investigation earlier this month found nearly 50 instances of officers charged or accused of misusing the cameras, often to track romantic partners or family members. Six employees of the Savannah, Georgia police department were fired earlier this week for searching for friends and family using Flock technology. More than 50 agencies nationwide have canceled or suspended Flock contracts since the start of the year, according to tracking group DeFlock. DHS documents show broad surveillance of left-leaning groups during Minnesota immigration crackdown: The Department of Homeland Security an investigation into labor unions, climate groups, and progressive organizations during the Trump administration's immigration crackdown in Minnesota earlier this year. Homeland Security launched the investigation days after Border Patrol agents fatally shot nurse Alex Pretti in January, using administrative subpoenas to obtain years of financial records from the groups, according to the New York Times. Homeland Security obtained financial records of a number of non profits and prominent unions, including the Sunrise Movement, the Communications Workers of America, and the Service Employees International Union. Documents reviewed by the Times also detail an undercover surveillance operation in which agents infiltrated Signal group chats and took names and license plate numbers of people at meetings in churches, libraries, and parks. Prosecutors ultimately indicted 15 people connected to the "antifa" in June after presenting grand jurors with a slide claiming 18 groups, including the AFL-CIO, were part of a conspiracy to obstruct immigration agents. Homan defends ICE plan to equip officers with electric shock gloves : White House border czar Tom Homan Immigration and Customs Enforcement's plan to spend up to $20 million on electric shock gloves for officers, telling Fox News a de-escalation tool that could help avoid deadly force. The gloves, known as G.L.O.V.E. and manufactured by Compliant Technologies LLC, have drawn criticism from civil rights groups and Democrats amid concerns that ICE agents have been too quick to use force, with at least six people shot and killed by immigration agents since last year, including motorists in Maine and Texas last month. Homan said deployment of the devices would take "awhile" as the agency works out training protocols. Trump signs proclamations imposing drone tariffs, allowing limited foreign warship construction : President Donald Trump two proclamations Thursday, one imposing tariffs on drones and drone parts and another directing the Navy to allow limited foreign shipbuilding. The drone memorandum sets a 100% tariff on "particularly sensitive" drones and 25% on smaller, less security-sensitive models, alongside a 15% tariff on drones from the European Union, Japan, and several other countries, taking effect 21 days after signing, with tariffs on less sensitive components phased in after 180 days. The Navy directive orders War Secretary Pete Hegseth to replace the Advanced Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch Systems with traditional steam and hydraulic systems, establish a fifth naval shipyard, and temporarily permit foreign shipbuilders to construct up to two American warships in their own shipyards as part of efforts to accelerate production. Vance asks DOJ to investigate hospitals over transgender care: Vice President JD Vance the Justice Department a government report accusing hospitals of using misleading billing codes for transgender health procedures to secure insurance reimbursement, asking Attorney General Todd Blanche to investigate dozens of hospitals nationwide, according to Politico. The report from the Department of Health and Human Services, titled "Wolves in White Coats," found that providers billed nearly $50 million for puberty-blocking drugs for patients ages 9 to 17 using endocrine disorder diagnosis codes rather than gender-related ones. The report was released two days after the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services cut off Medicaid funding for gender-affirming care for minors. Major medical groups including the American Medical Association and American Academy of Pediatrics support gender-affirming care and have criticized the administration's actions, with AAP President Susan J. Kressly warning that "allowing the government to determine which patient groups deserve care sets a dangerous precedent." DOJ finds California prisons systematically fail to protect women from guard sexual abuse : The Justice Department that California's prison system has systematically failed to protect incarcerated women from sexual abuse and harassment by guards, with staff tasked with investigating misconduct often themselves accused of abuse. Federal judge dismisses Trump administration 's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard: Judge Richard G. Stearns of the U.S. District Court in Massachusetts the Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard University Thursday, ruling that the antisemitic incidents cited in the March lawsuit were "too isolated and episodic" to show the school violated Title VI of the Civil Rights Act. The lawsuit had accused Harvard of turning "a blind eye to antisemitism and discrimination against Jews and Israelis" following pro-Palestinian campus protests after the Gaza war began in 2023. Progressive Florida slate rally moves to church after venue tried to bar Rashida Tlaib: A Friday "Chomp the Oligarchy" rally for a slate of progressive Florida candidates in the Fort Lauderdale area was to a church after its original venue canceled the original booking unless organizers agreed to bar Rep. Rashida Tlaib from speaking, a campaign spokesperson told Drop Site's Ryan Grim. The rally, organized with the Florida Youth Justice Coalition, Gen-Z for Change, and Miami DSA, features Tlaib and Senate candidate Angie Nixon , alongside congressional candidates Elijah Manley(FL-20) and Oliver Larkin (FL-25) and Colorado Democratic congressional nominee Melat Kiros. 📥 Have a tip on Capitol Hill? Last month, Galarza first for Drop Site that the Ecuadorian prosecutor assigned to investigate the attacks and 36 survivors' allegations of kidnapping and torture by U.S. personnel, told a colleague she was facing internal pressure and institutional stonewalling that was preventing her from pursuing potential U.S. involvement. She was assassinated on June 14. Russia rejects Black Sea ceasefire proposal: Russia a proposal for a ceasefire on cargo shipping in the Black Sea amid intensifying attacks in recent weeks that have increased global grain prices. Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova called it a "deliberate policy aimed at destabilizing civilian shipping in the Black Sea," as a result of Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in the region and rejected the idea of returning to a previous 2022-2023 ceasefire on ships carrying grain. The rejection comes after Turkey had floated proposals to both sides for a halt to military operations at sea. Reuters also reported that Ukraine separately transmitted an offer through a third party to stop attacks on civilian targets. UN warns that 650,000 refugees in South Sudan could lose food aid: UN agencies that more than 650,000 refugees and asylum seekers in South Sudan could lose access to food assistance within weeks because of a severe funding shortfall, with the World Food Programme (WFP) saying no refugees may be receiving food aid by October unless new money is secured. The warning comes as South Sudan faces one of the world's worst hunger crises, with 7.8 million people experiencing acute food insecurity and 2.2 million children acutely malnourished. The WFP says it needs $37 million for refugee operations to avoid ceasing aid to 180,000 internally displaced people by October and hundreds of thousands more by this winter. Chadian president pardons jailed opposition leaders: Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Deby former prime minister and main opposition leader Succes Masra, along with eight other opposition figures, ending prison terms that critics had denounced as politically motivated. RSF confirms Kurmuk capture as fighting escalates across Sudan: The UAE-backed RSF said it seized , the strategic Blue Nile border town on Thursday, with regional monitors reporting Ethiopian support for the operation. Clashes continued there and in Amburu, North Darfur. In North Kordofan, the army said it repelled an RSF assault involving more than 250 combat vehicles on Jabra al-Sheikh, while two civilians were killed in RSF drone strikes on El Obeid, according to Emergency Lawyers. RSF drone attacks were also reported on Khartoum and Omdurman for a second consecutive day. Hundreds across Canada target Elbit suppliers in "people's arms embargo": Activists with Arms Embargo Now picketed facilities from British Columbia to Newfoundland on Thursday, targeting more than 40 companies tied to Israeli arms manufacturer Elbit Systems, including Ontario-based TTM Technologies, which has shipped millions of dollars in circuit boards for precision-strike munitions. The campaign has already pushed Montreal-based Apollo Microwaves to end its Elbit contracts and Scotiabank, once Elbit's largest foreign shareholder, to divest its roughly $500 million stake. body:

Peter,
It’s a long and proud tradition in Wisconsin that we make things. From paper, engines, and tools to even the best beers, brats, and cheese, we’re proud that so much is **Made in Wisconsin.**
I’m proud to champion the workers behind all our traditions. I was proud to support the Infrastructure and Jobs Act, which created hundreds of thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs. Creating a manufacturing economy that is built to last is made by investing in workers and the next generation of Wisconsin’s manufacturers.
I will always support our hard-working families in our state, and work to create more high-paying jobs, more workplace protections, the right for collective bargaining, and keeping jobs in our state.
This is why I first ran for Congress, and why I continue to fight for workers in Congress.

name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
subject: I won’t be on the ballot…
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
For the first time in nearly a decade, I won't be on the ballot this November.
I'll be honest — that's a strange thing to sit with. For years, asking for your vote has been how I showed up in this fight. This year, that's not an option for me.
But here's what hasn't changed: I am not going anywhere.
I started Equal Opportunity Now because I refuse to sit on the sidelines while Donald Trump and his MAGA allies try to dismantle everything that made my family's story possible. Not being on the ballot doesn't change that belief. If anything, it's freed me up to do something I care about just as much: help elect the next generation of Democrats who will fight for working families and take back power from MAGA extremists.
That's not just a talking point. This month alone, Equal Opportunity Now is putting $100,000 directly into the hands of Democratic candidates and causes — in Illinois and around the country. We're doing it because I know firsthand what it takes to run a campaign, and I know how much difference an early, real investment can make for a candidate who's ready to fight but needs the resources to do it.
I've spent my career fighting for fair wages, for a democracy that works for everyone, for an economy where hard work still leads somewhere. I'm not done fighting for any of that just because my name isn't on a ballot this year. If anything, I'm just getting started in a new way — finding the leaders who will carry this fight forward, and making sure they have what they need to win.

My name may not be on the ballot. But I'm still all in.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

| | **Today marks 91 years since the creation of Social Security.** On this day in 1935, the monumental 37-page Social Security Act was signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt. And now, most Americans do not remember a time before Social Security. In the years since its adoption, the landmark legislation has evolved into a euphemism for retirement benefits. But it is more than just a monthly check for retirees - **it is a safety net for**** _everyone_****that provides financial stability and peace of mind throughout life.** Social Security includes: **Retirement Security:** The most common connotation of Social Security is the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in our golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. **Disability Protection:** Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. **Survivor Benefits:** Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. **Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital.** But Social Security and its beneficiaries are vulnerable right now. The Big Ugly Law has made catastrophic cuts to important programs like Social Security. I am furious about the devastating cuts Republicans have rushed through this year with the Big Ugly Law. **To me, it is plain and simple: hardworking folks paid into Social Security, and it is not a handout.** I oppose the privatization of Social Security and support proposals that make the benefit formula more generous, use cost-of-living formulas that consider the expenses of seniors' purchases, and preserve Social Security for the future by scrapping the cap on income subject to Social Security taxes. **Social Security demonstrates our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for**** _everyone_****, regardless of their socioeconomic status.** And as a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security, I am redoubling my efforts to fortify these protections. name: Swing Left
subject: This is how we meet voters where they are (online!)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
All you need is your phone and an hour of your time.
#
Hi there,
In 2026, control of Congress and state governments will come down to competitive races in the swing districts and states where Swing Left volunteers are already organizing to help rebuild trust in Democrats and turn out voters in this year’s midterm elections.
And as more voters get their news and information online, reaching them means making sure our messages can break through in the places where they’re already spending time.
**Today, we’re excited to announce an entirely new way to volunteer! We’re hosting a Social Bank on Thursday, August 20th at 7 PM ET, and we’d love for you to join us.**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2248?utm_source=em20260814-2446&t=1&akid=2446%2E1562180%2EBpr0lW)
A social bank works kind of like a phone bank. Volunteers show up together at a set time, but instead of calling voters, they spend an hour engaging with pro-Democratic content on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X (formerly Twitter).
Likes, comments, shares, and watching videos all the way through all juice a post in the algorithm, generating more views—and when a group of people do this together, the effect compounds—**giving Democratic messages a better chance of reaching people who aren’t already following political accounts or looking for political content.**
Republicans showed us in 2024 that they are capable of winning elections by meeting voters online and sharing content to reach persuadable voters. Now, we need to do the same thing for Democrats.
[**So if you can spare an hour of your time on August 20th at 7 PM ET, click here to RSVP for our Social Bank now.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2248?utm_source=em20260814-2446&t=2&akid=2446%2E1562180%2EBpr0lW)
**[Take Action Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2248?utm_source=em20260814-2446&t=3&akid=2446%2E1562180%2EBpr0lW)**
No special experience or huge following is required. Just bring your phone and a friend. We’ll bring everything else you need to get started! And just like a phone bank, we’ll kick things off together, walk you through the strategy and materials, and then take action as a group.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do.
— The Swing Left Team
P.S. Can’t make it this time? We’ll be hosting Social Banks weekly, [**so find another week that fits your schedule here.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2248?utm_source=em20260814-2446&t=4&akid=2446%2E1562180%2EBpr0lW)

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260814-1&t=5&refcode2=2446_1562180_Bpr0lW&akid=2446%2E1562180%2EBpr0lW)

91 years ago today, FDR signed the Social Security Act, establishing one of the cornerstones of our modern society and enshrining into law the American ideal that if you work hard throughout your life, you are entitled to a retirement.

Generations of Americans have worked hard to pay into Social Security so they can retire with dignity — with the benefits they earned and are owed.

Cutting this program shouldn’t even be on the table for discussion, but that’s not stopping Mike Johnson from putting it on the chopping block:

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137235107/640101431/-642992695?refcode=260814em_sjj_socialsecurity&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDA1YzA4MC1mZjk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bNLoglfNguvgUBS0alkOm53VnTk5ekN8n3_TPB4jKrA=)

More than three-quarters of Americans (of _all_ political persuasions) oppose cutting Social Security. I’m guessing that includes you, and it definitely includes me!

We’ve heard it straight from the horses’ mouths that they’re willing to slash Social Security and Medicare to fund whatever this President’s extreme agenda demands, whether that’s handing out tax breaks for billionaires and corporations, or pouring more money into the cruel and chaotic ICE and Border Patrol agencies, or some other awful thing we haven’t even gotten wind of yet.

**I refuse to let that happen, so I am fighting tooth and nail to flip the House this November and get Mike Johnson OUT of power.**

Fellow American Patriot, Mike Lindell here, founder of MyPillow and [_**candidate for Minnesota Governor.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlnH_SzDC6ekm3SPXDnwoS-TDff1-xWw6ZDPjR-L_Et847EtVnXtnLNGPYXdqSe90Q_-Mr8RkEo3m8-LPSgRFMRA50n1kOk8kGSLL3mI8Q) I'm reaching out because this week, I made one of the biggest decisions of my life. After 22 years leading the company I founded, I've stepped down as CEO of MyPillow. I didn't make that decision lightly. For more than two decades, MyPillow has been my life's work. Together, we built a Minnesota company from the ground up, created jobs, and proved that with faith, perseverance, and hard work, incredible things are still possible in this wonderful country.So why would I step away now?[**It's simple: because Minnesota deserves a Governor who is 100% committed.** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlnH_SzEsgPK7JHeSKe0LHPeqZj2vIFvRotGad8bjASC5FXWYnzjyNVEUeeqi1S49KndkMyzQLBNke1Ps_XQaCXmmKtCuTQBoosRbYCq5w)Minnesota deserves my complete focus, my full energy, and my undivided attention.I'm all in. 100% -- And today I'm hoping you're all in too.[**Will you click here to make a generous contribution to my campaign to take back our state and make Minnesota Great Again?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlnH_SzFbsBN3R2bTnL9OFfvgD0rvVRkCNVwBPxBFrJ80R5q0SQa0sC1k1sOPDjGhjLKNGMH-PNaItRC0bBsQRF_iYTkGnLUwW8OMMElFA) My friend, this decision wasn't about walking away. It's about stepping up for you. Career politicians spend their lives protecting what's best for themselves. They worry about their next title, their next election, and their next opportunity.I'm choosing a different path. I'm putting Minnesota ahead of myself. I'm choosing the fight to save Minnesota and I'm giving it my all. I don't have a backup plan. I'm all in. President Trump honored me with his endorsement because he knows I'll fight for Minnesota without compromise. Now I'm backing up those words and his confidence with action by giving 100% to this campaign. But I can't do it by myself. **[I need grassroots conservatives across Minnesota-and across the country-standing with me.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlnH_SzGfvi-ijkOM2Ym177L6qrBmbJ1GAc0ojCt5B-gL9i8fsBbtPy7O43RpY5NbrYjK5NukUU-_Ngm7_M4uyp5tdR_XR9fDGLgYuN7hQ)** _**_Every phone call we make..._**_ _**_Every yard sign we print..._**_ _**_Every door we knock..._**_ _**_Every voter we reach..._**_ It's only possible because people like you decide this campaign is worth fighting for. **If you believe Minnesota deserves a Governor who's willing to sacrifice, willing to lead, and willing to put our state first, I'm asking you to stand with me today.** **[Will you make a contribution of $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford to help me win this race?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njh9AAwAAAAAAlnH_SzHhJWiroI9qkop0keefHgjf2FgpZJ6WJhprsleFOuOmQIT16rOoSAU5VtB3vtncIDFlHEEKfqAjk3GRjENstEgoZta-uorqT0hgg)** **_Together, we can save Minnesota._** **_I'm all in. I hope you'll be all in with me._**
---
| | | Thank you, and God bless.
---
**Mike Lindell,** _**Republican Candidate for Governor**_

| | As moms, we know that protecting our families starts with staying informed. That's why we're speaking up about an issue that deserves greater attention: the difference between natural kratom and dangerous Synthetic 7-OH products. Natural kratom is a relative of the coffee plant and helps millions of Americans each year, serving as a plant-based wellness product for years. But high-potency Synthetic 7-OH products have entered the marketplace with growing concerns about consumer safety and the need for stronger safeguards, especially to help keep these products out of the handsof children. Watch this [short video](https://momsforamerica.us/so/1bQ00yg5A/c?w=owUKEI89XIS6zspm8urJSkgG1SSTkhg3ObWycfeF7X0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj05Ti1kcEpUUkxNNCIsInIiOiI3OTkwY2JlNy1lZWM1LTQ3Y2EtOTcxZi0zYWYwNTdiOWI2NmMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ) to learn why Moms for America Action believes we don't have to choose between protecting families and preserving access to natural kratom. name: Win Without War
subject: Last year was widely described as the worst Palestinian olive harvest in living memory. This year, we are trying to change that.
body:
Win Without War’s partners are ensuring Palestinian farmers aren’t facing this year’s harvest alone.
#
"Without the harvest, I will die. Really, I will die.”[1]
Last fall, Yousef Dar al-Musa, a 67-year-old farmer, was violently blocked by settlers from reaching his family's land in the West Bank. His story is not unique.
**Normally, proceeds from selling olive oil carry Dar al-Musa’s and other Palestinian families through the year. It’s a livelihood passed down through generations, but the 2025 olive harvest was widely described as the worst in living memory:** Across village after village, trees stood heavy with fruit that no one could safely pick in the face of settler attacks and Israeli military closure orders.
Combatants for Peace (CfP) — a courageous movement of former Israeli and Palestinian fighters and other committed activists working together through nonviolent action to build a peaceful future — is directly supporting families displaced by home demolitions and settler violence, including through protective presence during this year’s olive harvest in the West Bank.
Simultaneously, Win Without War is continuing our work to mobilize partners across the movement to act alongside hundreds of thousands of grassroots activists to end U.S. complicity in the violence people experience there, in Gaza, and beyond.
With settler violence on the rise and Israel’s far-right government accelerating a land grab in the occupied West Bank, it’s clear that we must work harder. **We’re issuing an urgent challenge to this incredible community to raise $25,000 for our two organizations working across borders to build a world where Palestinians and Israelis can live in safety.**
**[Let’s turn a season of fear into a season of hope. Will you make a donation that will be split 50/50 between Win Without War and Combatants for Peace?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22965?t=1&akid=1705%2E2118727%2ET-8YNV)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22965?t=2&akid=1705%2E2118727%2ET-8YNV)**
Settler violence is becoming all too normalized in the West Bank, and it’s not exclusive to Palestinian farmers. Earlier this summer, Congressman Ro Khanna experienced firsthand just how dangerous conditions have become when armed settlers detained him, and Israeli soldiers prevented him from leaving._If a sitting member of the U.S. Congress can be detained like that, imagine what the average farmer faces every single harvest season._
Win Without War works every single day to help stop the violence and create the conditions necessary for peace, demanding a genuine, permanent ceasefire in Gaza, opposing U.S. weapons transfers to the Israeli government, and resisting dangerous efforts to deepen military integration between the Pentagon and IDF. **But we know we won’t change this horrific situation alone, which is why we work closely with incredible grassroots groups on the frontline.**
Win Without War is proud to support CfP because they embody the kind of courageous, people-powered peacebuilding we believe is possible — working to end the occupation, resist all forms of violence, and build a future based on freedom, equality, justice, and peace for all — even amidst unimaginable violence.
**As the violence rages across the West Bank and beyond, we know how easy it can be to feel hopeless. But time and time again, our community gives us the hope we need to keep going. When hawks push toward war, we turn to the peacemakers. Join us.**
[**Please make a split donation today to help us reach our $25,000 goal for Win Without War and CfP. Your gift will help remind communities living under incredible violence and occupation that they have not been forgotten.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22965?t=3&akid=1705%2E2118727%2ET-8YNV)
We know that we won’t create the change we need to truly keep people in Palestine, Israel, Iran, Lebanon, or the United States safe alone. Our team at Win Without War is honored to work alongside such incredible partners in this critical moment — because we know that the impossible becomes achievable when we work together.
With your support, we’re changing the discussion about what ‘security’ really means, and building a world where people can thrive without the threat of violence.
Thank you for working for peace,
The Win Without War team

Peter,

Here’s what this month looks like for us here in the Central Valley. Triple-digit heat, the AC running nonstop, and a PG&E bill that climbs right along with the temperature.

I grew up watching my family stretch every dollar just to get through months like this one. So it's hard for me to look at what David Valadao has done and not see who he's actually working for.

**He's taken nearly $100,000 from PG &E over the years. Then he voted to make it easier to build data centers and hand tax breaks to utilities just like PG&E.**

PG&E got lower overhead. You got a higher bill.

That's the trade Valadao made.

And PG&E's answer to your rising bill isn't to lower it now. It's a promise that a massive new buildout of AI data centers across the Valley, that no one in our community wants, will bring rates down eventually.

It's not complicated. Valadao took their money, then voted to cut their costs while ours went up. That's what happens when a member of Congress answers to a utility company instead of the people paying that company's bills.

# **[Bill Gates daughter busted over alleged unearned commissions scam](https://substack.com/redirect/c24ef3b8-bbba-4515-893b-6e3faf336578?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Phoebe Gates and Phia co-founder Sophia Kianni reportedly pushed features allowing their shopping startup **[to claim affiliate commissions on sales it did not drive,](https://substack.com/redirect/534d1a75-fbfe-4206-b309-083a8883a818?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with knowledge of the practice since December.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c24ef3b8-bbba-4515-893b-6e3faf336578?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Awareness timeline conflict:** Bloomberg reported the founders knew of cookie stuffing since December via Slack messages, contradicting their July 8 claim they learned of it within the last 24 hours and blamed a software bug.
* **How the scheme worked:** Phia's browser extension places tracking cookies during checkout without user intent, claiming credit for purchases on sites like Nike, Gap and Nordstrom even if unused.
* **Partners ban the practice:** Commercial partners prohibited cookie stuffing, yet the startup used three different strategies; Impact.com suspended Phia from its marketplace after the initial report.
* **Funding and company background:** Phia launched in April 2025, raised $30 million in December at a $180 million valuation from investors excluding Bill Gates after an earlier $8 million seed.

# **[Selena Gomez sued by investors: She promised 500 million followers, delivered nothing](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Pop star Selena Gomez[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/05548d6c-8599-4dd7-838a-8bc2058d75d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[is accused of fraud by five investors](https://substack.com/redirect/05548d6c-8599-4dd7-838a-8bc2058d75d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who claim she failed to leverage her celebrity status and more than 500 million social media followers to promote the collapsed Wondermind mental-health startup.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Lawsuit targets three founders:** Five investors filed a Thursday lawsuit in Delaware federal court against Gomez, mother Mandy Teefey and Daniella Pierson alleging the app was never built and revenue never materialized.
* **Company raised five million:** Wondermind Global Inc. raised $5 million in a 2022 early-stage round from Serena Williams's venture fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Sequoia Capital while claiming a $95 million valuation.
* **Gomez ignored marketing duties:** As chief impact officer and head of marketing, Gomez failed contractual obligations to promote the mental fitness company partly due to long-running personal struggles with her mother Teefey.
* **Founders stayed silent years:** For three years while the company quietly collapsed around them, not one of its founders, officers or directors said a word to the investors about the failed initiatives.

# **[Uber cuts a deal with China to flood Europe with 2000 robo taxis](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Uber and China's Pony.ai plan to deploy **[2,000 robotaxis across Europe](https://substack.com/redirect/14a1e429-e386-482f-93fd-5409121d5c92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and the Middle East after a Zagreb launch, while Unitree prices a $900 million IPO and firms like[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8997650a-f20f-4f24-ab25-0cfe521d8739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Apple and Ford deepen Chinese tech use.](https://substack.com/redirect/8997650a-f20f-4f24-ab25-0cfe521d8739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **European robotaxi fleet expansion:** Uber and Pony.ai will deploy 2,000 self-driving taxis across Europe and expand to the Middle East after their claimed first commercial European service launched in Zagreb this spring.
* **Unitree IPO valuation details:** Hangzhou-based Unitree priced shares at 150.8 yuan to raise $900 million at a $9 billion valuation, with retail demand oversubscribed more than 5,000 times and DeepSeek investing.
* **Humanoid commercial limits remain:** Unitree **[robots perform backflips and kung fu kicks yet face questions on useful work,](https://substack.com/redirect/813e0a6b-6126-48d8-a10e-17bca8f481bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** limited to about 4 hours of runtime with hands lacking the precision needed for daily tasks.
* **Western firms source Chinese:** Apple partners with Alibaba and Baidu for AI in China while Ford uses CATL battery technology for a $3.5 billion Michigan plant amid Chinese dominance in the EV market.

# [Anthropic takes IPO meetings, but no one is talking numbers](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Anthropic[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/19f93b7f-6f9a-44e0-a7e5-9d6b80949f0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[CFO Krishna Rao is leading high-level meetings](https://substack.com/redirect/19f93b7f-6f9a-44e0-a7e5-9d6b80949f0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with prospective investors ahead of a potential IPO, covering Claude models and enterprise strategy while avoiding specific financials or valuation, sources said.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Claude models focus areas:** Meetings cover Claude AI models, Claude Code development, enterprise market position, management composition and release volume without any specific financial details or targets.
* **May funding valuation metrics:** Anthropic closed a late May funding round at a $965 billion valuation after its run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion, up from roughly $10 billion in 2025.
* **Investor valuation growth outlook:** **[Some investors independently project a $2 trillion or higher IPO valuation,](https://substack.com/redirect/2b744b49-67b1-45ec-92a6-238d9de88477?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with half a dozen backers seeing $100 billion to $120 billion annualized revenue by year-end.
* **Pricing controls litigation risks:** One investor cites 800% annual growth supporting over $3 trillion at 30 times revenue, amid higher model pricing, temporary export controls and Defense Department litigation.

# [Why JPMorgan cut off the biggest prediction market](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan Chase[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/a19182c6-693d-48ba-8006-df9b7e44fd34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[terminated its banking relationship with prediction market Polymarket last year](https://substack.com/redirect/a19182c6-693d-48ba-8006-df9b7e44fd34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over regulatory concerns according to the Financial Times, though it retains some ties for a potential IPO role.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Notification issued in October:** JPMorgan notified Polymarket in October that it needed to find a new bank, the Financial Times reported citing people it did not identify.
* **New lender now engaged:** Polymarket is working with a new lender that the report did not identify while a JPMorgan representative declined to comment on the matter.
* **Partial ties still retained:** The bank retains some ties and is leaving the door open for an underwriting role should Polymarket attempt to go public, according to a familiar source.
* **Industry faces regulation fight:** Prediction markets have grown into a multi-billion dollar industry with sports wagers dominating trades and standing at the center of a wide-ranging regulatory debate.

# [Cisco beat earnings hard and the stock still crashed 8%](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Cisco shares **[dropped 8.4% Thursday even after reporting fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $17.3 billion,](https://substack.com/redirect/d427aaba-592e-422e-8a83-1ffa4a3e317e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** up 18%, and guiding current-quarter revenue to $18 billion to $18.2 billion, both above estimates.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Guidance called conservative:** Piper Sandler said the numbers were good but guidance looks conservative given current demand, and some investors may nitpick that peak growth is already visible in the results.
* **Hyperscaler order strength:** Hyperscalers placed $4 billion of infrastructure orders in the quarter for a $9.3 billion fiscal-year total, with related revenue expected to nearly double to $7.5 billion next year.
* **CEO defends prudent start:** Chuck Robbins told CNBC the company delivered a record year and quarter yet chose to start the new fiscal year a little bit prudent while operating in incredible markets.
* **Analysts stay supportive:** KeyBanc remains bullish expecting market share gains as hyperscalers and neoclouds ramp spending, while the stock had risen more than 60% year-to-date before the drop.

# [Intel's $20B raise dilutes holders, BofA keeps the Buy rating](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bank of America **[maintained a Buy rating on Intel after its $20 billion stock offering](https://substack.com/redirect/1cf1b230-0b85-492f-b4c8-5dc54749de70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of 210.5 million shares at $95 each, while lowering the price target to $145 from $160 due to dilution and sector multiples.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shares climb on BofA note:** Intel shares climbed more than 3% Wednesday after Bank of America maintained its Buy rating saying the offering could support expansion of the company's foundry operations.
* **Offering creates dilution impact:** The $20 billion offering involves 210.5 million shares priced at $95 each and is estimated to create four- to five-percent dilution for existing holders according to the analysis.
* **Foundry strategy remains central:** BofA estimates Intel could capture a portion of the global wafer-manufacturing market by 2030 while expanding its role in advanced chip packaging to support higher earnings.
* **Server pricing strengthens sharply:** Server average selling prices reached about $1,200 in the second quarter, up 43% from a year earlier, though execution risks remain around yields, process ramps and winning large customers.

# [AI's $1 trillion problem no one can buy their way out of](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hyperscalers **[aim to spend up to $1 trillion on AI data centers in 2026,](https://substack.com/redirect/423e1962-677f-4400-a010-92d3e30d8c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** but persistent chip shortages, skilled labor gaps, regulatory pushback and a projected 19-gigawatt power shortfall threaten to slow the build-out.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Spending forecasts escalate:** Goldman Sachs estimates global spending will reach $1 trillion in 2026, JPMorgan forecasts $697 billion in the US, and Bank of America sees a path toward $1.2 trillion by 2027.
* **Multiple bottlenecks emerge:** Chip shortages persist despite new capacity, construction faces skilled labor shortages, and regulatory constraints include a one-year New York moratorium plus a Texas power hookup audit.
* **Analyst warns of delays:** Canaccord Genuity's George Gianarikas said the combination of equipment, permits and people needs plus protests and moratoria means power will not arrive at the expected pace.
* **Power approvals limited:** Wood Mackenzie reported utilities and grid operators may approve only 28% of requested data center power due to phantom applications and those from less-experienced operators.

# [JPMorgan analyst sees 30% more upside in Microsoft as Azure explodes](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee raised his Microsoft price target to $625 from $550, **[implying about 30% upside, citing accelerating Azure and M365 growth](https://substack.com/redirect/105b67bf-2738-4d1b-87cd-1417c8a93664?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** driven by AI infrastructure buildout and lower capital needs than peers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Analyst hikes price target:** JPMorgan's Samik Chatterjee lifted Microsoft's price target to $625 from $550 on Thursday, assuming about 30% upside from current trading levels based on AI-driven growth.
* **Azure growth accelerates sharply:** Azure and other cloud services growth surged 43% in the fiscal fourth quarter as the business officially crossed the $100 billion annual revenue milestone with enterprise AI deployments at scale.
* **Strong quarterly results delivered:** Microsoft posted $90 billion in revenue up 18% year over year along with operating income rising 18% to $40.6 billion while returning $10.2 billion to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
* **Lower capital needs advantage:** The company demonstrated operating leverage and did not aggressively raise its capital expenditure plans like peers Alphabet and Meta while significantly building out data center capacity.

# [S&P 500 inclusion sends Reddit soaring, AI is the bigger story](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Reddit shares **[rose more than 15% in early trading](https://substack.com/redirect/650d489a-d2ca-4169-9e25-d5a5093a3b63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after S&P Dow Jones Indices said the platform will join the S&P 500 prior to the open on August 18, replacing AvalonBay Communities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AI advertising opportunity:** Co-founder Steve Huffman said people frustrated with AI slop and useless summaries are gravitating toward Reddit's long human conversations, creating potential for more advertising sales.
* **Strong second-quarter results:** The company reported a 61% year-over-year revenue increase to $805 million driven by advertising, with earnings per share rising 178% to $1.25 in the period.
* **User base continues expanding:** Global unique daily active users reached 130.3 million, up 18% year over year, fueled by a 28% international surge and 36% rise in average revenue per user.
* **Consistent sales growth streak:** Sales have increased by more than 10% in each of the past 13 quarters according to Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace analysis of the platform's performance.

# [Sandisk's 540% rally just got rocket fuel from the AI memory boom](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Sandisk shares **[rose 3% on Friday after a 12% prior-session climb](https://substack.com/redirect/eff16613-a117-4c8c-97cf-9bb03c6d0f0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the NAND flash maker set mid-to-high teens revenue growth targets and near 80% gross margins for 2028-2030.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7868b137-264b-411b-84a9-573c87bd5916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Multi-year customer contracts:** RBC Capital noted the deals are multi-year, detailed by quarter or month, carry fixed pricing plus a variable element, and include financial guarantees supporting sustainability.
* **Sustainable cycle outlook:** Raymond James analysts said the guidance points toward sustainable margins and returns with lower volatility through the cycle despite volatile trends and unprecedented demand.
* **Unique AI positioning:** JPMorgan assigned an Overweight rating as analyst Harlan Sur said Sandisk is uniquely positioned to capture structural NAND demand growth driven by rapid AI inference expansion.
* **Major year-to-date gains:** Spun off from Western Digital in February 2025, Sandisk has gained more than 540% this year as memory emerged as a key AI infrastructure bottleneck with deficits extending ahead.

The richest man in the world spent nearly $300 million in the 2024 presidential election to elect Donald Trump. Then, he spent more than $20 million to defeat now-elected and JanePAC-endorsed Judge Susan Crawford in Wisconsin’s 2025 Supreme Court race. Now, Elon Musk has pledged to spend at least $100 million through his super PACs ahead of November — and he’s eyeing races where our endorsed climate champions are fighting to bring principled leadership to long-ignored communities. This type of spending from an outside group is staggering, but we cannot let billionaires bully us into complacency. From the moment I founded my Climate PAC, candidates have told me the same thing again and again: early support and consistent support give them the resources they need to take on deep-pocketed spenders — and win. clean_body: I received a heartbreaking message I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Fellow Patriot, I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Tyler was a commercial pilot for 14 years... until Joe Biden 's TSA revoked his commercial pilot's license for "suspicion of terrorism" without even being charged with a crime. As a result of his lost pilot's salary, Tyler's family business is now in bankruptcy, and he, his wife, and their four kids are in desperate need of your support. I promised Tyler Stand in the Gap could help raise the funds he needs to get his company back on track, and Fellow Patriot, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment: My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends. After President Trump's speech, I went to the Capitol. What I saw with my own eyes did not match what the news reported. On March 26, 2021, the TSA revoked my commercial pilot 's license for "suspicion of terrorism" and being a threat to the national airspace -- before I was ever charged with a crime and before any FBI interview.I spent $40,000 in legal fees. In June 2021, Allegiant fired me. Without my W-2 income, I could no longer sustain the construction company my wife and I owned. It is now in bankruptcy. We have four children. I now work 6-7 days a week in construction just to survive. I'm hoping Stand in the Gap can help us raise $25,000 to stabilize our family and our company during this bankruptcy and help us recover from the financial destruction caused by the sudden end of my aviation career. We have nowhere else to turn. Thank you for anything you can do. -- Tyler Tew Tyler's story is why we started our Fund Their Futures fundraising program, Fellow Patriot. President Trump's pardons gave these patriots back their freedom... but that did NOT give them their lives, careers, businesses, or homes back. Tyler did everything right for decades... building a wonderful career, a small business, and a loving family. It all ended WITHOUT due process ... simply because the Far-Left wanted to punish him for supporting President Trump. Your gift today will give Tyler and his family breathing room. It'll help stabilize their company and help them keep a roof over their heads. Stand with the Gap exists specifically for moments like this... to when the legal fight is over, but the fight to survive has just begun. Too often, Stand in the Gap is the for the men and women who faced political persecution and financial ruin after January 6. We exist to share the burden and make it lighter ... and your generosity is quite literally the difference between families like Tyler's losing everything. That's why I hope you'll step forward, Fellow Patriot. Even just a few dollars could make a critical difference. Thank you so much for helping them out. I have spent this whole campaign talking about the war on public education, and this is what it looks like. There is a real contempt for learning and expertise creeping through this country right now, and Texas is out front leading it. Look at what happened in McKinney. Our own school district just had to shut down three neighborhood elementary schools because the money ran dry. Those schools had 11 to 13 kids per teacher, the kind of small classes most parents would give anything for, and they got closed anyway. [**Help us send someone to Congress who treats teaching our kids like the national priority it ought to be.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt86R6VnHmOo0-C_HafW8D5wLld2ZAUxeeKKC8J0isqjNWRf1D6GnmDB1QQPyEvdnvifhs8OSG3JSVD34GMwleDr0wvX5Wya4ojHG21jzqh1FEfZMAqixTMPc_cmwUEWX3YLFORop9VOjoAqyDF7ZPP7XWeXPuJsqlDcnJ5IEbGYpfOyNzThgkomXmAZ2hc4pivNCQIEHMb0w4d2Rdxdt_EkiCa0w58m6Vcje7N7NcvapddIE1cC7XG79kA4zH2JeMUlQEOjaaUX7fJwE71bQOGBJKEX7Z3aAldMD2ZhzBm05uFdBsqwbgOvcFo3CC06uTCpwGNpo1SJbOlsvcq50P8Dpp4hHgBWFARqqgGItTJR-A/4t6/kWVh8eSnSLqIXCrPVobyZw/h3/h001.wP1u8vTkEE4R1zIYqEqmDataVeTIFmUFXQkCDfEXwGU) The men who founded this country would not have stood for any of this. Thomas Jefferson talked about a wall of separation between church and state. James Madison said tangling up government and religion ends up wrecking both of them. These were men who had just gotten out from under a country with an official religion, and they built ours so that no politician would ever get to hang his favorite scripture over your kid's desk. **That was the entire point.** And yet Keith Self will holler all day about Sharia law taking over Texas while staying dead silent on the state bolting one religion's scripture to every classroom wall. He drapes himself in the Constitution while he cheers on the thing it was written to prevent. He is one more MAGA extremist who would let Christian nationalism run right over this government if we handed him the chance. clean_body: The hypocrisy running Texas education. | | Peter, Kids across Texas went back to school this week, and a new state law meant a lot of them walked in to find the Ten Commandments hanging on the classroom wall. Including in my own daughter's classroom: | The extremist politicians in Austin who forced those posters up clearly have not read them very closely. There is a commandment in there about not bearing false witness, and telling families there is no money for their schools while sitting on a billion dollars for private school vouchers sure sounds like bearing false witness to me. I have spent this whole campaign talking about the war on public education, and this is what it looks like. There is a real contempt for learning and expertise creeping through this country right now, and Texas is out front leading it. Look at what happened in McKinney. Our own school district just had to shut down three neighborhood elementary schools because the money ran dry. Those schools had 11 to 13 kids per teacher, the kind of small classes most parents would give anything for, and they got closed anyway. The men who founded this country would not have stood for any of this. Thomas Jefferson talked about a wall of separation between church and state. James Madison said tangling up government and religion ends up wrecking both of them. These were men who had just gotten out from under a country with an official religion, and they built ours so that no politician would ever get to hang his favorite scripture over your kid's desk. That was the entire point. And yet Keith Self will holler all day about Sharia law taking over Texas while staying dead silent on the state bolting one religion's scripture to every classroom wall. He drapes himself in the Constitution while he cheers on the thing it was written to prevent. He is one more MAGA extremist who would let Christian nationalism run right over this government if we handed him the chance. We know that's an unusual ask. But here's the thing about beating a 21-year incumbent like Doris Matsui: it's not going to happen because we out-spend her. It's going to happen because we out-organize her all across CA-07.

And that kind of organizing runs on people, not big checks. Every $1 adds up to something real:

$1 helps keep our organizers knocking doors across Sacramento, Elk Grove, and beyond.

$1 helps us reach voters by phone and text we'd never find otherwise.

$1 proves that a movement of everyday people can go toe-to-toe with the corporate machine that's propped up this seat for two decades — and win.

Doris Matsui is already sitting on money from corporate PACs, insurance companies, and DC insiders who've never knocked on a single door in this district. What we have is you — showing up again and again, in amounts as small as a single dollar.

Yep. That’s how we feel when Emerge women win. We know you feel the same.

**And this email is to celebrate the hard work and victories of Emerge alums across the country who advanced to the general election this month, including:**

🍁First-time candidate **Amanda Janoo** , who won her primary for**** Vermont Governor, seeking to flip the governor’s mansion red to blue, and **Molly Gray** , who won her primary for Vermont’s Lieutenant Governor. If elected, the pair would be the first all-Emerge governor and lieutenant governor in history.

🎸**La Sonya Hall** , who beat 10 other candidates to win her primary for Shelby County, Tennessee Clerk as a first-time candidate.

🧀**Jenna Jacobson** , a **Wisconsin State Representative** running for higher office to flip a state senate seat, a seat critical to flipping the Senate chamber blue for the first time in a decade.

📜**Connecticut State Representative Maryam Khan** , who won a contested state senate primary running for higher office.

🐺**Michigan State Representative Natalie Price** , running for an open state senate seat, and **Lisa McIntyre** , a first-time candidate running to fill an open state house seat, who won their primaries.

🌲First-time candidate **Jaelynn Scott** , running for state house, who would be the first out transgender person to serve in the Washington legislature if she wins in November.

⚔ **Henrico County Commonwealth’s Attorney Shannon Taylor** , who won her hotly contested primary for Virginia’s 1st Congressional District, to flip the seat from red to blue in November.

🦡**JoCasta Zamarripa** , a **second-term Alderperson and former State Representative** , who stepped up to run for Wisconsin Secretary of State to protect the vacancy of Emerge alum **Sarah Godlewski** , the Democratic nominee for Wisconsin Lieutenant Governor. |

name: Troy Jackson
subject: I grew up in a working-class family
body:
| |
---
Friend, I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash. We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet. My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly. _“Take the pay cut or go home,”_ they were told. I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family. I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too. And it’s _that fight_ I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians. Now’s our chance to change that. We have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families. ### About Nellie Pou

clean_body: | | Friend, I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash. We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet. My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly. “Take the pay cut or go home,” they were told. I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family. I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too. And it’s that fight I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians. Now’s our chance to change that. We have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = I appreciate your support always, Troy = | | | ---|---|--- About Nellie Pou Nellie Pou is the first Latina to represent New Jersey in Congress, and will be a target for the NRCC in 2026. | | Hi Peter,
Ever since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, With Honor Action has advocated in support of our Ukrainian allies’ fight for democracy. Right before heading out of town last week, the U.S. Senate passed [the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act of 2026](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2fa117dcd1&e=33f53a5b1a), the most comprehensive sanctions package since the invasion began.
The Senate-passed bipartisan bill now heads to the House, where With Honor Action will continue working alongside members of the For Country Caucus to support its passage. This push builds on previous wins, including legislation to seize Russian assets and direct them toward Ukraine's rebuilding, and a law to help identify and bring home Ukrainian children abducted by Russia.
Learn more about the sanctions [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=b2dd15fc42&e=33f53a5b1a).

| | Petty Officer Brandon Caserta died by suicide in 2018 after facing institutional roadblocks when he tried to get help. His story led to the [Brandon Act](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=da2645fb15&e=33f53a5b1a), letting service members request confidential mental health referrals outside their chain of command.
The [Brandon Act Training and Protocol Act](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=7ff965baa0&e=33f53a5b1a) [(H.R. 6383)](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=701a14ba5f&e=33f53a5b1a) will standardize protocols on every military base and provide real training for commanders and medical staff to respond to urgent self-referrals.
In 2023 alone, 523 service members died by suicide. For veteran Members of Congress, the issue is often personal. That's why For Country Caucus members Reps. Gil Cisneros and Jen Kiggans secured this bill's inclusion in the House-passed FY27 NDAA. Now it needs to cross the finish line.

| | Is political courage dead? That's the question that With Honor Co-Founder and CEO Rye Barcott tackled this week in a wide-ranging conversation with Tim Boyum, a journalist who has interviewed more than two dozen presidential candidates and a sitting president, on _Tying It Together_.
The two dug into the ideas behind [_Courage Can Save US_](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ccbb1b60a0&e=33f53a5b1a), profiling 10 Americans Rye believes exemplify the kind of courage needed to navigate today's political climate. They discussed why so many Americans feel disillusioned with Washington, what sets veteran leaders apart from career politicians, and what it would actually take to fix a broken system.
Watch the full conversation [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=54e5c628c7&e=33f53a5b1a).

The book is accompanied by a [Teacher’s Guide](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=452cc9db93&e=33f53a5b1a) with ready-to-use lessons in civics, service, and leadership, designed to help educators bring the book’s themes to life in the classroom and encourage students to think about their own role in their communities.

In 1971, a
corporate lawyer wrote a memo with a simple plan: capture America's
institutions. Its political parties. Its media. Its legislatures. And
above all, its judges and courts.

50 years later, that plan succeeded. The federal bench is now stacked with
judges who owe their seats to megadonors, not the law — and they're ruling
for corporations and billionaires at every turn, leaving working families
with high prices and stagnant wages.

They call it trickle-down economics. We call it theft.

Here's the part that matters most: every federal judge is confirmed by the
Senate. Win the majority, and you can stop the rubber-stamping. Lose it,
and the courts stay captured for another generation.

That's the fight James Talarico is walking into. He's running for U.S.
Senate to get corruption out of politics and make life affordable again —
end the tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy, rein in corporate price gouging,
and fight for a judiciary that answers to the law instead of the donor
class.

He's done it before. As a Texas state legislator, James flipped a Trump
district and took on the billionaire megadonors and puppet politicians
controlling Texas — and won.

Now he's ready to be one of the votes in Washington that stops
greenlighting compromised judges onto the bench, so the courts and our
government start working for families instead of the wealthy.

This race is winnable. And it won't be won with billionaire money. It'll
be won by grassroots donations — the kind that let James compete without
ever answering to the donor class that captured the courts in the first
place.
